blocks.translation: ● This product is intended for Ages 15+. Never give to children under this age. ● This product contains small parts and batteries; take care that small children do not accidentally swallow them. There is a risk of choking. ● Do not use near the ear. Misuse may cause hearing damage. ● This product uses electronic components; people with pacemakers should exercise caution. Do not put fingers or other body parts into gaps of moving parts — there is a risk of pinching and injury. ● Do not play roughly, such as by throwing or swinging the product. Do not stare at flashing LED lights for long periods — there is a risk of feeling unwell. Misuse of batteries may cause overheating, rupture, or leakage. Observe the following: ● If battery fluid gets into the eyes, immediately rinse with plenty of water and consult a physician. If leaked fluid gets on the skin or clothing, wash with water. ● Batteries are dangerous if swallowed. Keep out of reach of children. ● Do not use secondary batteries (rechargeable batteries) under any circumstances. Do not mix old and new batteries or different types of batteries. Set the polarity correctly (＋−). ● After use, be sure to turn off the switch and remove the batteries. Leaving batteries installed may cause leakage. Do not short-circuit, recharge, disassemble, heat, or throw batteries into fire. ● When disposing of batteries or this product, follow your municipality's disposal instructions.

blocks.text: 台詞
blocks.translation: lines

blocks.text: 俺、変身したいんだ。 もっと強くて、なんでもできる自分に。
blocks.translation: I want to transform into someone stronger who can do anything.

blocks.text: 初瀬! 待て! やめろ!
blocks.translation: Hatsuse! Wait! Stop!

blocks.text: オレンジって・・・俺!?
blocks.translation: Orange...me!?

blocks.text: 20 やめてくれ! そいつは人間だ! 俺たちの仲間なんだよ!
blocks.translation: 20 Stop it! He's a human! He's one of us!

blocks.text: えっ? 舞? 舞なのか?･･･俺は･･･ でも俺は、お前を守るためなら・・・!
blocks.translation: Eh? Mai? Is it Mai?... I... But I... if it's to protect you...!

blocks.text: やめろおーーー!!
blocks.translation: Stop it!

blocks.text: どうして･･･どうして殺した・・・ そいつは!
blocks.translation: Why... why did you kill... him!

blocks.text: これが俺の…変身･･･。
blocks.translation: This is my transformation...

blocks.text: そうだ、コイツを使いこなせなかったのは、 自分だけのために使おうとしたからだ。
blocks.translation: That's right, the reason I couldn't use it properly was because I was trying to use it only for myself.

blocks.text: シドぉ･･･。 この野郎･･･ふざけんな!
blocks.translation: Sid... You bastard... Stop messing around!

blocks.text: でも、みんなを守るために使うなら、きっと・・・!
blocks.translation: But if it's used to protect everyone, surely...!

blocks.text: えっ? じゃ、花道オンステージって...。
blocks.translation: Huh? So, Hanamichi on stage...

blocks.text: や、やめろって! なんでだ!? なんでアンタと戦わなきゃならない!?
blocks.translation: S-Stop it! Why? Why do I have to fight you?

blocks.text: おかしいよな?俺はただインベスゲームに参加していただけだ。
blocks.translation: Isn't that crazy? I was just playing the Inves game.

blocks.text: バロンとの勝負だって、 ルールの中で勝ち負けを競ってた。 でも気づいたんだ。
blocks.translation: Even in my match with Baron, I was competing within the rules to see who would win or lose.

blocks.text: そのベルトの力は、そんな生やさしいもんじゃない。
blocks.translation: The strength of that belt is not that easy.

blocks.text: あの戦極って奴の言いなりになるつもりはない。 力そのものが必要なんじゃない。
blocks.translation: I have no intention of doing whatever that Sengoku guy tells me to do. It's not power itself that I need.

blocks.text: 肝心なのはその使い道だろ。 ユグドラシルは研究だけが目当てで、 この街を守るつもりがない。
blocks.translation: The important thing is how it's used. Yggdrasil's only purpose is research, and they have no intention of protecting this city.

blocks.text: だから、俺がこの街のみんなをインベスから守る。 必要なのはそのための力だ。
blocks.translation: That's why I will protect everyone in this town from the Inves. What I need is the power to do so.

blocks.text: ただ強くなればいいってわけじゃない。
blocks.translation: It's not just about becoming stronger.

blocks.text: 遊び半分なんかじゃなく、生きるか死ぬかを決めるためのものなんだって。
blocks.translation: It's not just for fun, it's something that will determine whether you live or die.

blocks.text: シド・・・。 もう二度と! 俺たちはお前に騙されたりしない!
blocks.translation: Sid... Never again! We won't be fooled by you!

blocks.text: 分かるんだ。 そのベルトを使い続ければ、 いつかまたアイツが俺の前に現れる。
blocks.translation: I know. If I keep using that belt, someday he'll appear before me again.

blocks.text: 無責任なお前たちに代わって、俺が沢芽市をインベスから守る!
blocks.translation: I will protect Zawame City from the Inves in place of you irresponsible people!

blocks.text: 次はもう逃げ切れない。 だから俺は… 俺はもう… 変身できない･･･。
blocks.translation: Next time I won't be able to escape. So I... I can't transform anymore...

blocks.text: お前たちの計画が本当に立派なものなら、 なにも知らない人たちを巻き込んで、
blocks.translation: If your plan is truly good, you should involve innocent people.

blocks.text: 舞 ベルトをくれ!違うんだ舞! 今度こそ俺のためだ!
blocks.translation: Mai, give me the belt! No, Mai! This time it's for me!

blocks.text: 見殺しにして! 平気でいられる訳がない!
blocks.translation: Letting them die! There's no way I can remain calm!

blocks.text: 俺は俺自身のために戦う! そのための力が欲しい。
blocks.translation: I will fight for myself! I want the power to do so.

blocks.text: 黙れ! それでも俺は、 初瀬を殺しておきながら、それを正義だと言ったお前を許さねえ!
blocks.translation: Shut up! But I still can't forgive you for killing Hatsuse and then calling it justice!

blocks.text: あのベルトは俺にしか使えない。 俺にしか出来ないことをやり遂げるための力!
blocks.translation: That belt is only for me to use. It gives me the power to accomplish things that only I can do!

blocks.text: すべてアンタの嘘に踊らされながら身につけた力だ! 思い知れ!
blocks.translation: All of this power was acquired while being manipulated by your lies! Learn your lesson!

blocks.text: 俺はそいつを引き受ける!そいつがきっと、大人がよく言う責任てやつだろ!
blocks.translation: I'll take responsibility for it! I guess that's what adults often talk about as responsibility!

blocks.text: 俺たちはこれからもずっと友達だろ。
blocks.translation: We'll always be friends.

blocks.text: 違う! 強さは力の証明なんかじゃない!
blocks.translation: No! Strength is not proof of power!

blocks.text: 俺は戦わなきゃならない。 ここで絶対に負けられないんだ!
blocks.translation: I have to fight. I absolutely cannot lose here!

blocks.text:
強いヤツの背中を見つめていれば、心砕けたヤツだって、もう一度立ち上がることができる!
誰かを励まし、勇気を与える力! それが本当の強さだ!
blocks.translation:
If you look into the backs of strong people, even a broken-hearted person can get back up again! 
The power to encourage and give courage to someone! That is true strength!

blocks.text: ユグドラシルの思うようにはさせない! この街は、俺が守ってみせる!
blocks.translation: I won't let Yggdrasil have its way! I'll protect this city!

blocks.text: 俺は絶対に諦めない!
blocks.translation: I will never give up!

blocks.text: 輪切りにしてやるぜ!
blocks.translation: I'll slice you into rings!

blocks.text: ここからはみんなのステージだー!
blocks.translation: From here on, it's everyone's stage!

blocks.text: 俺たちはアンタらの思い通りにはならない。 今日はそれを伝えに来た。
blocks.translation: We won't do what you want us to do. I'm here to tell you that today.

blocks.text: 覚えてるか? アンタと最初に会ったのもこんな感じの場所だった。 アンタは忘れても
blocks.translation: Do you remember? The first time we met was in a place like this.

blocks.text: 最後の戦いだ! さあ、ショータイムだ!
blocks.translation: It's the final battle! It's showtime!

blocks.text: 俺はしっかりと覚えてる。 アンタに言われたことも。 この世界には理由のない悪意が
blocks.translation: I remember clearly what you said to me. There is malice in this world that has no reason.

blocks.text: ああそうかもな! だがユグドラシルなんて関係ねぇ! ヤツらの狙いがなんであれ、
blocks.translation: Ah, maybe! But Yggdrasil has nothing to do with it! Whatever their goal is,

blocks.text: いくらでも転がってるって。 その悪意のせいで初瀬は死んだ。 そうなんだろ?
blocks.translation: There are plenty of them lying around. Hatsuse died because of that malice. Isn't that right?

blocks.text: クラックが開けばヘルヘイムのインベスに襲われるんだぞ!
blocks.translation: If the crack opens, we'll be attacked by the Inves of Helheim!

blocks.text: でもそれが仕方ないことだって俺はどうしても思えない。 そして許せねえ。
blocks.translation: But I just can't see that this is inevitable. And I can't forgive it.

blocks.text: それを止められるのはこのベルトだけ! ベルトが使える俺だけだ!
blocks.translation: The only thing that can stop it is this belt! I'm the only one who can use the belt!

blocks.text: その悪意を作っているアンタらユグドラシルが。
blocks.translation: It is you, Yggdrasil, who are creating this malice.

blocks.text: やめろ初瀬、落ち着け! やめろ!お前を助けたいだけなんだ!
blocks.translation: Stop it, Hatsuse, calm down! Stop it! I just want to help you!

blocks.text: 俺はあの時の俺とは違う!
blocks.translation: I'm not the same person I was back then!

blocks.text: お前に初瀬の心が残ってるなら、 今すぐにこんなことはやめてくれ。
blocks.translation: If you still have Hatsuse in your heart, stop doing this right now.

blocks.text: 38 思い違いだと!? 初瀬が死んだのは思い違いか!?
blocks.translation: 38A Misunderstanding!? Hatsuse's Death is a Misunderstanding!?

blocks.text: もし・・・もしお前がこのまま続けるっていうなら...。 お前はもう初瀬じゃねえ!!
blocks.translation: If... if you continue like this... you're no longer Hatsuse!

blocks.text: アンタにそんなことを決める権利があんのか!!
blocks.translation: Do you have the right to decide something like that?!

blocks.text: 台同
blocks.translation: Dialogue

blocks.text: 台同
blocks.translation: Dialogue

blocks.text: 俺はアンタを絶対許さねえ!!
blocks.translation: I'll never forgive you!

blocks.text: 無駄なんかじゃない。確かに人は傷つけ合うけど、それだけじゃない。
blocks.translation: It's not a waste. Sure, people hurt each other, but that's not all.

blocks.text: おかしいだろ･･･。 こんな時こそ人間てひとつになるんじゃないのか?
blocks.translation: Isn't that strange...? Isn't this exactly the kind of time when people should come together?

blocks.text: きっと分かり合うことだってできる。 俺はそれを信じて戦う!
blocks.translation: I'm sure we can come to understand each other. I will fight with this belief!

blocks.text: みんな滅びるってわかったら、お互いに争ってる場合じゃないだろ!
blocks.translation: If we know we're all going to perish, we have no time to fight each other!

blocks.text: そうか･･･そういうことだったのか……。お前はずっとひとりで、頑張ってたんだな・・・。
blocks.translation: I see... so that's what it was... You've been working hard all by yourself all this time...

blocks.text: え、なんだよそれ。アンタたち、人類を救うんじゃなかったのかよ!
blocks.translation: What the hell is that? Weren't you guys supposed to save humanity?

blocks.text: 見ていてくれラビス。 俺は必ず取り戻す。 傷つけ合う必要のない世界を･･･!
blocks.translation: Watch over me, Ravis. I will definitely take it back. A world where there is no need to hurt each other...!

blocks.text: ふざけんな!
blocks.translation: Don't mess with me!

blocks.text: 俺は俺は･･･うおおー!
blocks.translation: I, I...Whoa!

blocks.text: 俺は逃げない。アンタたちの好きにはさせない!
blocks.translation: I won't run away. I won't let you guys do as you please!

blocks.text: 目的が正しくたって、やり方を間違えてたら意味がない。 やっと分かった。
blocks.translation: Even if the purpose is correct, it's meaningless if the method is wrong. I finally understand.

blocks.text:
すまん裕也･･･。 誰が仲間か、誰のための世界か、そんなことはどうでもいい! ここには、
死なないでいて欲しかったヤツがいた。そしてまだ、生き延びて欲しい人たちが残ってる!
blocks.translation: I'm sorry, Yuya... I don't care who my allies are or who this world is for! There was someone here I didn't want to die. And there are still people I want to survive!

blocks.text: ヘルヘイムの秘密も、世界のピンチも! ユグドラシルにはまかしておけない!
blocks.translation: The secrets of Helheim and the world in danger! We can't leave it to Yggdrasil!

blocks.text:
迷って何が悪い!? 夢見て何がおかしい!? アンタこそ言ってることがデタラメだ!
ロクでもない計画ばかり立てといて、ふざけんな!
blocks.translation:
What's wrong with wavering!? What's strange about dreaming!? You're the one who's saying nonsense!
You're always making useless plans, stop messing around!

blocks.text:
俺の味方かどうかなんて関係ない! 守りたいものは変わらない! たとえ俺自身が変わり果てたとしても!
犠牲なんかじゃない! 俺は俺のために戦う! 俺が信じた希望のために! 俺が望んだ結末のために!
blocks.translation:
It doesn't matter if you're on my side or not! What I want to protect won't change! Even if I myself have changed completely!
It's not a sacrifice! I'll fight for myself! For the hope I believe in! For the ending I want!

blocks.text: そうだ俺は･･･後悔なんてしない。
blocks.translation: Yes, I... I have no regrets.

blocks.text: ぜってえ許さねえ・・・!
blocks.translation: I'll never forgive you...!

blocks.text: 俺は誓ったんだ!後悔なんてしないって!
blocks.translation: I swore I'd never regret it!

blocks.text: ユグドラシル! もう絶対許さねえ!
blocks.translation: Yggdrasil! I'll never forgive you again!

blocks.text: 俺が、みんなを守るんだー!
blocks.translation: I'll protect everyone!

blocks.text: から聞いたぞ。 プロジェクトアークとかいう戯言を
blocks.translation: I heard about this nonsense called Project Ark.

blocks.text: レデュエー! お前みたいなヤツは、ここで俺がぶっ潰す!
blocks.translation: Redue! I'll crush people like you right here!

blocks.text: アンタらのやり方は絶対に許せねえ!
blocks.translation: I'll never forgive you for the way you're doing things!

blocks.text: もうやめよう。 俺たちほんとは、傷つけ合う必要なんてないんだ。
blocks.translation: Let's stop this. There's really no need for us to hurt each other.

blocks.text: アンタはほんとに街のみんなをボタンひとつで皆殺しにしようとしてたのか!
blocks.translation: Were you really planning to kill everyone in the city with the push of a button?

blocks.text: おい、大丈夫か!?
blocks.translation: Hey, are you okay?

blocks.text: なんの罪もない人たちを大勢見捨てて、なにが未来だ! ふざけんな!
blocks.translation: What kind of future do you have if you abandon so many innocent people?! What a joke!

blocks.text: そのロックシードはヤバい! 早く変身を解け!
blocks.translation: That Lockseed is dangerous! Undo the transformation quickly!

blocks.text:
犠牲だと!? 冗談じゃねえ! 犠牲と引き換えに希望なんて冗談じゃねえんだよ!
そんなものはただの絶望だ!
blocks.translation: 'A sacrifice'!? You've got to be kidding! The idea of hope in exchange for sacrifice is a joke! That's nothing but despair!

blocks.text: なにバカなこと言ってんだ!
blocks.translation: What a stupid thing to say!

blocks.text: あ、おい、光実! やめろ! これ以上はお前の体がもたない! なあ! やめよう! なあ! おい!
blocks.translation: Ah—hey, Mitsuzane! Stop! Your body can't take much more! Come on, let's stop this! Hey!

blocks.text: なにがおかしい!?
blocks.translation: What's wrong?

blocks.text: それほどの覚悟なのか! 俺も、覚悟するしかないのか!
blocks.translation: Is that how determined you are?! I have no choice but to prepare myself too!

blocks.text: 裕也……。 ああ、 裕也･･･そんな･･･まさか･･･。
blocks.translation: Yuya... Ah, Yuya... that can't be...

blocks.text: やめろ光実! もうそのロックシードは使うな!
blocks.translation: Stop it, Mitsuzane! Don't use that Lockseed again!

blocks.text: もうよせ! 死ぬ気か!?
blocks.translation: Stop it already! Are you trying to die?

blocks.text: 俺は･･･どうすればいいんだ･･･。 俺は･･･ユグドラシルの連中が許せないって
blocks.translation: What should I do? I can't forgive the people at Yggdrasil.

blocks.text: だって・・・ 俺たち･･･ この間まで・・・仲間・・・だったじゃないか･･･。
blocks.translation: Because... we were friends... until recently...

blocks.text: そう思って戦ってきた。 それなのに、俺もアイツらと一緒だった。
blocks.translation: That's what I thought as I fought. And yet, I was just like them.

blocks.text: お互い、どこで間違えたのか、 どこが分かれ道なのか･･･ 正直俺には、よく分からない。
blocks.translation: Where did either of us go wrong? Where did our paths cross? To be honest, I don't really know.

blocks.text: 誰かを守るといいながら、そのために別の命を犠牲にしてた。
blocks.translation: You say you were protecting someone, but you were sacrificing other lives to do it.

blocks.text: でもな・・・そんなに昔の話じゃ・・・ないと思うんだ･･･。 だから、引き返そう･･･。
blocks.translation: But... I don't think it was that long ago... So, let's go back...

blocks.text: じゃあ戦う意味ってなんなんだ!? 誰を助けて誰を見捨てるか、
blocks.translation: So what's the point of fighting? Who should we save and who should we abandon?

blocks.text: バカだなミッチ、これから先･･･どれだけ長く歩くか分かってんのか。 それに比べりゃ、大したことないって…。
blocks.translation: You're such an idiot, Mitch. Do you know how long the walk is going to be? It's nothing compared to that.

blocks.text:
好きに選べるってだけのことなのか･･･? そんなんで本当に何かを守るって言えんのか!?
俺には、壊したいものなんてない。 そんな力なんて欲しくもない。
blocks.translation:
Is it just a matter of being able to choose whatever you want...? Can you really call that protecting something!?
There's nothing I want to destroy. I don't desire that kind of power.

blocks.text: ああ許す。 だからお前も、許してやれよ。 今日までの、 自分の間違いを。
blocks.translation: All right — I forgive you. So you should forgive yourself too, for the mistakes you've made up to today.

blocks.text: バカだなあ舞は。 なんで全部ひとりでしょい込んでんだ。 お前が前に言ってくれたじゃないか。
blocks.translation: Mai is so stupid. Why did you have to take on everything by yourself? You told me before.

blocks.text: 世界を･･･変える? 俺が?
blocks.translation: Change the world? Me?

blocks.text: ひとりで苦しまなくていいって。 あの言葉があったから俺は、今までがんばれたんだ。
blocks.translation: You don't have to suffer alone. Those words have allowed me to persevere until now.

blocks.text: 守るためじゃなく、壊すための力だとしても・・・そうだ。 あの言葉をブチ壊せるなら。
blocks.translation: Even if it's not a power to protect, but a power to destroy... that's right. If I can destroy those words.

blocks.text: だから今度は俺が同じことを言ってやる。 ひとりで苦しむな。 俺が舞と一緒に戦ってやる。
blocks.translation: So now it's my turn to say the same thing. Don't suffer alone. I'll fight alongside you.

blocks.text: お前達の諦めを、 絶望を、 ぶち壊す方法があるのなら!
blocks.translation: If only there was a way to destroy your resignation and despair!

blocks.text: ずっと前から決めてたことだ。
blocks.translation: It was something I decided a long time ago.

blocks.text: まず最初にぶっ潰さなきゃならないのは! 俺たちの街を絶望させるもの!
blocks.translation: The first thing we need to destroy is the thing that brings despair to our city!

blocks.text: 舞 俺たち、確かにたくさん間違えて、たくさん苦しんだけどさ、 だけど全部、 全部自分で選んだ道なんだ。
blocks.translation: Mai: It's true that we made a lot of mistakes and suffered a lot, but it was all a path that we chose ourselves.

blocks.text: いや、アンタたちのおかげで分かったんだ! 本当に戦わなきゃならない相手が!
blocks.translation: No, thanks to you guys I now know who I really need to fight!

blocks.text: だから運命なんて関係ない。 運命が変えられなくたって、 どおってことねえよ。
blocks.translation: So fate doesn't matter. What's the point if fate can't be changed?

blocks.text: 確かに俺は過ちを犯した。 だからこそ、 同じ過ちが繰り返されるのを見過ごせない!
blocks.translation: I have certainly made mistakes, and that is why I cannot stand by and watch the same mistakes being repeated!

blocks.text: だってまだ未来は、 決まっちゃいないんだからな。
blocks.translation: Because the future hasn't been decided yet.

blocks.text: 俺は諦めない! 犠牲が必要だっていうならそれを求めた世界と戦う!
blocks.translation: I won't give up! If sacrifices are necessary, I'll fight against the world that demands them!

blocks.text:
これでもう証拠隠滅なんて出来ねえぞ! 全部秘密にしておきたいなら、本気で街をインベスから守れ!
俺は裕也を死なせちまった。 そんな自分が許せない、だから! もう後には退けないんだ。
blocks.translation: Now there's no way to destroy the evidence! If you want to keep everything a secret, you have to seriously protect the city from the Inves! I let Yuya die. I can't forgive myself for what I did, so I can't back down now.

blocks.text:
なんでなんだよ戒斗･･･。 俺はお前が世界を救ってくれるってんなら、 黄金の果実を譲っても構わないと思ってたのに。
お前ってヤツは・・・お前は俺が止める!
blocks.translation: What's wrong, Kaito... I was willing to give up the Golden Fruit if you would save the world. You... I'll stop you!

blocks.text: 本当は、 薄々分かってたんだ… 食欲が無くなってからも、 美味そうだって思えたのは・・・。
blocks.translation: Actually, I had a vague idea... Even after I had lost my appetite, I still thought it looked delicious...

blocks.text: 今のユグドラシルのやり方を見過ごしたら、俺はまた大勢を見殺しにすることになる。
blocks.translation: If I overlook Yggdrasil's current behavior, I'll end up abandoning many people to death again.

blocks.text: そんな時は、 ミッチが真っ先に気づいてくれるさ! お前、俺よりも頭いいもんな。
blocks.translation: When that happens, Mitch will be the first to notice! You're smarter than me.

blocks.text: 諦めんのは早い。 まだ俺たちは出会ったばかりだ。
blocks.translation: Don't give up too early. We've only just met.

blocks.text: アンタが俺の言葉を信じてくれて助かった。
blocks.translation: I'm glad you believed my words.

blocks.text:
ああ・・・やっぱり美味い･･･。 ごめんな姉ちゃん。 俺もう･･･ 姉ちゃんの手料理食べられないや...。
いいんだ姉ちゃん･･･。 ほら、 前にも言ったことあっただろ。 今とは違った自分になりたいって。
これが正しいかどうかは分からない。 でもな、 今なら、今の俺なら正しい人たちの味方ができるんだ...。
いつだったか、お前と戒斗に聞かれたよな。 俺がどんな未来を望むのかって。 その答えが、
blocks.translation:
Ah... it's delicious as always... I'm sorry, sis. I'll never be able to eat your cooking again...
It's okay, sis... You see, I said it before, right? I want to be a different person than I am now.
I don't know if this is the right thing to do. But, now, as I am, I can side with the right people...
You and Kaito asked me one time, right? What kind of future I want? The answer was,

blocks.text: どうしたんだよ貴虎! なにすんだよ! ・・・なんでだよ･･･。 なんで戦うんだよ･･･。
blocks.translation: What's wrong, Takatora? What are you doing?! Why? Why are you fighting?

blocks.text: 本気なのか貴虎･･･本気で俺たちを・・・。
blocks.translation: Are you serious, Takato? Are you serious about us?

blocks.text:
なんとなく見えてきた気がするんだ。 だからそれを果たしに行く。 戒斗と、 そしてお前のために。
迎えに行くよ舞。 そう長くは待たせない。
blocks.translation:
I feel like I'm starting to see it somehow. So I'm going to go and make it happen. For Kaito, and for you.
I'll come and get you, Mai. I won't keep you waiting too long.

blocks.text: やめろ・・・。 やめろぉー!
blocks.translation: Stop it... Stop it!

blocks.text: 戒斗…。 お前は一体何がしたいんだ。
blocks.translation: Kaito... What exactly do you want to do?

blocks.text: 貴虎何故だ! 分かってくれたんじゃなかったのかよ! 答えろよ!
blocks.translation: Takatora, why?! I thought you understood! Answer me!

blocks.text: なんだよそれは・・・。
blocks.translation: What the heck is that...?

blocks.text: 違う! 人は分かりあえるはずだ! 俺も、仲間たちもそうやって今までやってきたんだ!
blocks.translation: No! People should be able to understand each other! That's how I and my friends have always done things!

blocks.text: 今の世界で、 それは無理だっていうのか。
blocks.translation: Is that impossible in today's world?

blocks.text: そうか･･･。 ああ分かったよ・・・。 お前を頼ろうとした俺がバカだった。
blocks.translation: I see... Ah, I understand... I was stupid to try to rely on you.

blocks.text: 強くて優しいヤツだって大勢いた。 みんなこの世界を守ろうとして必死だった!
blocks.translation: There were many strong and kind people. Everyone was desperately trying to protect this world!

blocks.text: 今なら分かる。 どうしてお前らの文明が滅びちまったのか!
blocks.translation: Now I understand why your civilization was destroyed!

blocks.text: きっと向こう側の世界にも未来があった。 なのにあの森に負けちまったのは、 お前のような奴がいたからだ!
blocks.translation: Surely the other world had a future. But the reason we lost to that forest was because of people like you!

blocks.text:
いいや、俺はお前だけには負けない。 お前を倒し証明してみせる。 ただの力だけじゃない。 本当の強さを!
うおおおおおおおおおっ!
blocks.translation:
No, I won't lose to you. I'll defeat you and prove it. Not just power. True strength!
Woooooooooo!

blocks.text: この力は! 戦えない人たちを守るために!
blocks.translation: This power is to protect those who cannot fight!

blocks.text: 戒斗ォー!
blocks.translation: Kaitoo!

blocks.text: 後悔なんてしてる暇はない! 俺は先に進む! そう裕也に誓ったんだ!
blocks.translation: I have no time for regrets! I'm going to move forward! That's what I promised Yuya!

blocks.text: 戒斗! 悲しみや絶望の他に、手に入れたものは無かったのか!? その怒りがお前の全てだったのか!?
blocks.translation: Kaito! Have you gained nothing other than sadness and despair? Is that anger your everything?

blocks.text: これが俺の…新しい力…。
blocks.translation: This is my new power...

blocks.text: 超えさせない、超えちゃならない! 戒斗、 それがお前にとっての俺だ!
blocks.translation: I won't let you go beyond that, you must not go beyond that! Kaito, that's who I am to you!

blocks.text: 79 ぜってえ助ける!
blocks.translation: 79 I'll definitely help you!
131 But still... I...!

blocks.text: 80 ミッチ・・・お前だったのか! じゃあ、本物の貴虎はどうなった!?
blocks.translation: 80 Mitch... it was you! Then what happened to the real Takatora?

blocks.text: うわああああっ! でやあああっ!
blocks.translation: Woahhh! Andyyy!

blocks.text: やめろ!
blocks.translation: Stop it!

blocks.text: 133 はぁあああああっ、えやああっ!
blocks.translation: 133Aaaahhh, yeahhhh!

blocks.text: 光実!
blocks.translation: Mitsuzane!

blocks.text: 守りたいという祈り･･･。 見捨てないという誓い･･･。 それが俺の全てだ
blocks.translation: A prayer to protect... A promise not to abandon... That's everything to me.

blocks.text: 多分アイツは、もう自分で物事を決められずにいる。 本当に自分が何をしたいのか考えるより先に、
blocks.translation: Maybe he can't make decisions for himself anymore. Before he can even think about what he really wants to do,

blocks.text: 泣いていいんだ･･･。 それが俺の･･･弱さだとしても···拒まない･･･! 俺は･･･泣きながら進む!
blocks.translation: It's okay to cry... Even if that's my weakness... I won't deny it...! I'll keep going while crying!

blocks.text: 昔ついた嘘に追い詰められて、こうするしかないって縛られてるんだ。
blocks.translation: I'm being driven into a corner by a lie I told long ago, bound by the idea that I have no choice but to do this.

blocks.text: あいつの理想は正しかった。 ただ道筋を間違えただけだ。 だから俺達が叶えよう。
blocks.translation: His ideals were right. He just took the wrong path. So we'll make them come true.

blocks.text: 一番辛かったのはミッチのはずだ。 でも俺には何もできなかった・・・。
blocks.translation: Mitch must have suffered the most. But there was nothing I could do...

blocks.text: 戒斗の夢を。 もっと正しい方法で。 俺の未来・・・見届けてくれるか?
blocks.translation: Kaito's dream. In a more correct way. Will you see my future through?

blocks.text: そうか･･･お前もあの赤いヤツと一緒か。
blocks.translation: I see... you're with that red guy too.

blocks.text: すべて、こいつのためだったのか･･･。
blocks.translation: So it was all for him...?

blocks.text: そんなものを楽しむために、 俺たちの世界を引っ掻き回してるのか!
blocks.translation: Are you turning our world upside down just to enjoy something like that!?

blocks.text: え!? ベルトと喋れんのか!?
blocks.translation: What!? You can talk to the belt!?

blocks.text: 俺はミッチを止められなかった。 アイツが卵を重ねるってんなら、オレが目を覚まさしてやる!
blocks.translation: I couldn't stop Mitch. If he's going to keep piling up eggs, I'll wake him up!

blocks.text: おおー! やっぱこう来たかー!
blocks.translation: Oh—! So that's how it was gonna be!

blocks.text: 俺たちが諦めたら、アイツは本当にひとりぼっちになっちまう…!
blocks.translation: If we give up, he'll truly end up all alone...!

blocks.text: 今は離れていても、地球を守りたい気持ちは同じだ!
blocks.translation: Even if we're apart now, our desire to protect the Earth is the same!

blocks.text: もうやめろ。 いい加減目を覚ませ!
blocks.translation: Enough. Wake up already!

blocks.text: 141 誰一人、見捨てないために!
blocks.translation: 141 So that not a single person is abandoned!

blocks.text: 騙されるか! 俺は絶対諦めたりしない!
blocks.translation: As if I'd be fooled! I will never give up!

blocks.text: 例え別々の世界だとしても、戦うときは一緒だ。
blocks.translation: Even if we're in different worlds, we'll fight together.

blocks.text: 黄金の果実だと? ふざけんな! お前なんてただの金メッキだ!
blocks.translation: Golden fruit? You've got to be kidding! You're nothing but gold plating!

blocks.text: おい! やるよ! お前が持ってた方がよさそうだからな。
blocks.translation: Hey! I'll give it to you! It seems like it'd be better for you to have it.

blocks.text: 台詞
blocks.translation: Lines

blocks.text: 台詞
blocks.translation: Lines

blocks.text: 騒ぐほどのことじゃない。 弱い奴が消えて、強い奴だけが生き残る。 当然のルールだ。
blocks.translation: It’s nothing worth making a fuss about. The weak will vanish, and only the strong will survive. It’s the natural rule.

blocks.text: 自ら新しい敵を求めず、憎まれることから逃げている。
blocks.translation: They don’t seek out new enemies; they run from being hated.

blocks.text:
俺はほんとの目的を見つけた。 ユグドラシルですら及ばない力。
誰に屈服することもない本物の強さ。 それを手に入れる。
blocks.translation:
I have found my true purpose. A power that even Yggdrasil cannot match.
True strength that will not bow to anyone. I will obtain it.

blocks.text: 貴様はただの臆病者だ。 その力は、強さとは程遠い!
blocks.translation: You’re just a coward. That power is far from true strength!

blocks.text: 奪い取り、踏みにじる。 それが本当の勝利の形。 力とは、強さの証を立てるもの。
blocks.translation: To take and trample. That is the true form of victory. Power is to prove your strength.

blocks.text: 貴様に足りないのはその覚悟だ!
blocks.translation: What you lack is that resolve!

blocks.text:
もうすぐ、すべての弱者に裁きが下る。 己の信じた強さにどれだけの価値があるのか、
ハッキリする日が来る。 どれほど圧倒的なものに踏みにじられ、絶望を味わったとしても、
それでも踊り続けられると言うなら、俺は、お前の強さを認めよう。
blocks.translation:
Soon judgment will befall all the weak. The day will come when it’s made clear how much value the supposed strength you believe in actually has.
No matter how overwhelmingly you’re trampled or how much despair you taste,
if you still say you can keep dancing, then I will acknowledge your strength.

blocks.text: 今から俺が、 本当の強さというものを見せてやる。
blocks.translation: Now I will show you what true strength is.

blocks.text: 俺にはどうでもいい! 自分の命も守れぬ弱者など、ハナから興味はない。
blocks.translation: I don’t care! I have no interest in weaklings who can’t even protect their own lives.

blocks.text: 誰だ?
blocks.translation: Who is it?

blocks.text: だろうな。
blocks.translation: I should have guessed.

blocks.text: フッ、俺は俺の道を選ぶだけ。 運命など知ったことか!
blocks.translation: Hah — I just choose my own path. Fate be damned!

blocks.text: だが、それはお互い様だ。 ヤツらが姑息なだけな弱者なら、俺がこの手で淘汰するまでだ。
blocks.translation: Still, that goes both ways. If those guys are just cowardly weaklings, I’ll eliminate them with my own hands.

blocks.text: これが･･･俺の力･･･
blocks.translation: This is... my power...

blocks.text: お前も力を手に入れた。 ならば、 未来は己の手で勝ち取ってみせろ。
blocks.translation: You’ve gained power too. Then seize your future with your own hands.

blocks.text: 力を手に入れただけでは意味がない。 使いこなせなければ、それまでだ!
blocks.translation: Merely getting power means nothing. If you can’t master it, that’s all there is!

blocks.text: 痛みには慣れてる。 この程度の痛み、 どうということはない。
blocks.translation: I’m used to pain. This level of pain is nothing.

blocks.text: 今さらノコノコやってきたか。 葛葉紘汰! 力に背を向けたお前に用はない。
blocks.translation: Showing up now, are you, Kouta Kazuraba! I have no use for you who turned your back on power.

blocks.text: いいや、ガキの頃から、俺はずっと耐えてきた! 弱さという痛みにな!
blocks.translation: No — since I was a kid I’ve endured it! The pain of being weak!

blocks.text: 腰抜けは腰抜けらしく、 そこで指を咥えて見てるがいい!
blocks.translation: Cowards should act like cowards — sit there and watch with your thumbs in your mouth!

blocks.text: フッ、やはり楽しませてくれるな。 鎧武!
blocks.translation: Hah, you really know how to entertain. Gaim!

blocks.text:
俺の体にはとっくにヘルヘイムの毒が回ってる。 どうせこのまま死ぬだけだ。 惜しい命じゃない。
アンタも実験は大好きだろう! ここまで毒に慣れた俺が、コイツを食ったら、一体どうなるか!
blocks.translation:
Helheim’s poison has long since spread through my body. I’m going to die anyway. It’s not a life I care about.
You love experiments too, right? I’m used to poison now — what would happen if I ate this thing?

blocks.text:
黙れ! 強さとは、奪うための力。 ただ一人、 誰が頂点に立つか決めるためのものだ。
貴様の腑抜けた綺麗事など、 俺は断じて認めない!
blocks.translation:
Shut up! Strength is power to take. It’s for deciding alone who will stand at the top.
I absolutely will not accept your weak, pretty words!

blocks.text: ハハハハハ･･･初瀬と同じくらいにはな。
blocks.translation: Hahahaha... about the same as Hatsuse.

blocks.text: これが･･･ヘルヘイムの力･･･世界を蝕み・・・染め上げる力・・・。 フハハハ、 フハハハハ…･･。
blocks.translation: This is... the power of Helheim... a power that corrupts the world... and stains it... Fuhahaha, fuhahahaha...

blocks.text: なんてパワーだ。 化け物か。 だが、 力技だけで勝てると思うな!
blocks.translation: What power. A monster, indeed. But don’t think you can win by brute force alone!

blocks.text: なるほど、 それが貴様のこだわりか。 案外つまらんプライドだな!
blocks.translation: I see — that’s your obsession. Rather a dull bit of pride!

blocks.text:
ユグドラシルは全てを奪っていった。 当然だ。 ヤツらは強く、そしてあの頃の俺は弱かった。
だが、今は違う。 俺は二度と誰にも屈服しない。
blocks.translation:
Yggdrasil took everything. Of course — they were strong, and back then I was weak.
But now it’s different. I will never submit to anyone again.

blocks.text: 貴様の真理など、 机上の空論。 俺の真理は、うおおおっー! このコブシの中にある。
blocks.translation: Your ‘truth’ is just idle theory. My truth is — wooah! — in this fist.

blocks.text: 果たしてどうかな。 俺は誰にも屈しない。 俺を滅ぼす運命にさえも!
blocks.translation: We’ll see about that. I will not bow to anyone — not even to a fate that would destroy me!

blocks.text: いいだろう、 借りを返してやる。
blocks.translation: Fine — I’ll pay back the debt.

blocks.text: 諦めるのもお前の勝手だ。 そうやっていつまでも這いつくばっていればいい!
blocks.translation: If you want to give up, that’s your choice. Keep crawling like that forever!

blocks.text: だったら仕事しろ!
blocks.translation: Then get to work!

blocks.text: 俺は違う。 何度世界に打ちのめされようと、戦うことをやめたりしない。
blocks.translation: Not me. No matter how many times the world beats me down, I will never stop fighting.

blocks.text: お断りだ!
blocks.translation: Refuse!

blocks.text: お前はなぜ俺についてくる。 お前の望みはなんだ。
blocks.translation: Why are you following me? What do you want?

blocks.text: そろそろ決着をつけるぞ!
blocks.translation: It’s about time we finished this!

blocks.text: フッ、いいのか? お前の生み出そうとしてる王は、世界を滅ぼす魔王だぞ。
blocks.translation: Huh, are you sure? The king you’re trying to create is a demon king that will destroy the world.

blocks.text: アーマードライダー? バカな、なんて強さだ・・・。
blocks.translation: Armored Rider? Impossible — what strength...

blocks.text: 無論だ。 始めるぞ。 俺が望む未来を手にするために。
blocks.translation: Naturally. Let’s begin. To seize the future I want.

blocks.text: 貴様らが俺たちより強いと、証明してみせろ。
blocks.translation: Prove that you are stronger than us.

blocks.text: 俺は新たな力を手に入れた。 この力を使って、 古い世界を破壊する!
blocks.translation: I have obtained a new power. With this power, I will destroy the old world!

blocks.text: フン、口先だけの腰抜けどもが!
blocks.translation: Hmph — all talk, you cowards!

blocks.text: 63 俺は黄金の果実を手に入れ、世界を作り変える。 誰にも邪魔はさせない!
blocks.translation: 63 I will obtain the golden fruit and remake the world. I will not let anyone interfere!

blocks.text: 次こそ決着をつけると言ったはずだ。 ここなら足手纏いになる奴もいない。
blocks.translation: I said we’d settle this next time. Here there’ll be no one to hold us back.

blocks.text: だったらお前はどうする!? 前にも言ったはずだ。 未来は己の手で勝ち取ってみろと。
blocks.translation: Then what will you do!? I already told you — seize your future with your own hands.

blocks.text: もっとも、貴様が足を引っ張らなければ、の話だがな。
blocks.translation: That’s only if you don’t drag us down, of course.

blocks.text: お前が求める未来はなんだ!?
blocks.translation: What future do you desire!?

blocks.text: 勘違いするな! 俺は俺の敵を砕くだけ･･･。 貴様の都合など知らん!
blocks.translation: Don’t get me wrong! I’m only going to crush my enemies... I don’t care about your convenience!

blocks.text: そうか、ならば俺と共に来い!
blocks.translation: Is that so? Then come with me!

blocks.text: 終わりだ・・・。
blocks.translation: It’s over...

blocks.text: 貴様も意外に役に立つ!
blocks.translation: You were surprisingly useful!

blocks.text: コイツには俺も借りがある。 ここは任せろ!
blocks.translation: I owe this guy too. Leave it to me!

blocks.text: 67 他の連中にも伝えろ。 俺の前に立ち塞がるなら、 容赦はしないと。
blocks.translation: 67 Tell the others: if anyone stands in my way, I will show no mercy.

blocks.text: だまれ･･･俺が屈しない限り、貴様が勝ったわけではない!
blocks.translation: Shut up... You haven’t won so long as I refuse to yield!

blocks.text: 舞は始まりの女となり、この時間軸から消えた。 アイツと再び未来で巡り合うためには、
blocks.translation: Mai became the woman of the beginning and vanished from this timeline. To meet her again in the future,

blocks.text: ナイトオブスピアってのは・・・。
blocks.translation: What is the Knight of Spear...?

blocks.text: 黄金の果実を手に入れるしかない。 その資格があるのは、俺と、 お前だけだ。
blocks.translation: We have no choice but to get the golden fruit. Only you and I are qualified for it.

blocks.text: なめるなよ、俺たちはいつだって本気だった。
blocks.translation: Don’t underestimate us — we were always serious.

blocks.text: 俺はこの世界を破壊し! 舞と黄金の果実を手に入れる! 決着をつけよう。 葛葉紘汰。
blocks.translation: I will destroy this world! I will take Mai and the golden fruit! Let’s settle this, Kouta Kazuraba.

blocks.text: それがどうした!
blocks.translation: So what of it!

blocks.text: お前はもっと強くなる。
blocks.translation: You will become stronger.

blocks.text: その言葉! 人を子供だと思ってなめている! 大人の奢りだ!
blocks.translation: That phrase! You’re underestimating people like children! That’s adult arrogance!

blocks.text: 70 黙れ!
blocks.translation: 70 Shut up!

blocks.text:
正義など知ったことではない! ユグドラシルがほんとに強者なのか、それを確かめる!
弱い者ほど人目を偽る。 お前らの隠し事が弱味なら、ユグドラシルは強者ではない!
blocks.translation:
I don’t care about justice! I’ll see for myself whether Yggdrasil are truly the strong ones!
The weaker someone is, the more they fake their public face. If your hidden things are your weakness, then Yggdrasil are not truly strong!

blocks.text: どうした葛葉! 貴様も黄金の果実を求めるなら全力で来い!
blocks.translation: What’s the matter, Kouta! If you also seek the golden fruit, come at me with everything you’ve got!

blocks.text: くだらん! どうして世界を救う義理などある!
blocks.translation: Ridiculous! Why would I owe the world the duty of saving it?

blocks.text: 俺はお前らを支配者の座から引きずり下ろす!
blocks.translation: I will drag you down from your seat of power!

blocks.text: むしろ、舞を手に入れるためだけに世界を滅ぼしても構わない。 俺はそう判断した!
blocks.translation: I wouldn’t hesitate to destroy the world just to get Mai. That’s my decision!

blocks.text: 協力だと? 俺はなにも納得してない! そもそも、なぜこの世界を守る必要がある。
blocks.translation: Cooperate? I don’t accept any of that! Why should we protect this world anyway?

blocks.text: これは俺とヤツとの勝負だ。 余計な手出しをするな。
blocks.translation: This is a match between me and him. Don’t interfere.

blocks.text: 平和のために秘密を守れだと? フッ･･･ハッハ･･･ふざけんな!
blocks.translation: Keep secrets for the sake of peace? Hah... ha... don’t make me laugh!

blocks.text: 74 死んだわけではなく、 未来で俺を待っている。 サガラの言葉は正しいようだな。
blocks.translation: 74 He isn’t dead — he’s waiting for me in the future. Seems Sagara was right.

blocks.text: そんな嘘偽りで塗り固められた世界などいっそ壊れてしまえばいい!
blocks.translation: A world plastered over with lies and deceit should just be destroyed!

blocks.text: 古いもの、弱いものは消え、 強くて新しいものだけが生き残る。
blocks.translation: The old and the weak will disappear; only the strong and the new will survive.

blocks.text: 戦うことを忘れた者に、生きる資格なんてない。むしろ、侵略は絶好のチャンスだ。 力のある者と、
blocks.translation: Those who’ve forgotten how to fight have no right to live. Invasion is actually the perfect opportunity.

blocks.text: 弱い者がはっきりと分かれる。 ヘルヘイムと戦って、生き延びた者だけが未来を掴めばいい。
blocks.translation: The weak will be clearly separated. Those who fight Helheim and survive can seize the future.

blocks.text:
力だけを信じ、弱者を踏みにじって来た人間たちのルールだ。 だから奴らも滅び去る。
より強いものが現れたことで、自らのルールで裁かれて消える。
blocks.translation:
This is the rule of people who trusted power alone and trampled the weak. So they too will perish.
When something stronger appears, they’ll be judged by their own rules and vanish.

blocks.text: 俺は貴様らを憎んでなどいない。 憎んでいるのは、あの時の俺の弱さだ!
blocks.translation: I do not hate you. What I hate is my weakness from back then!

blocks.text: 舞、お前が欲しい。 黄金の果実を俺に渡せ。
blocks.translation: Mai, I want you. Give me the golden fruit.

blocks.text: 俺は貴様が気に入らない。 それで十分だ!
blocks.translation: I don’t like you. That’s reason enough!

blocks.text: 77 選ばないし、区別もしない。 俺は果実を掴んだ最強の男として、お前を手に入れる。
blocks.translation: 77 I won’t choose or discriminate. As the strongest man to seize the fruit, I will take you.

blocks.text: 戦うべき相手がいるなら戦え! そうでなければ、 一生後悔するはずだ。
blocks.translation: If there’s an opponent you should fight, then fight! If you don’t, you’ll regret it for the rest of your life.

blocks.text: 違うな。それは貴様が弱いからだ。 弱者だからそんなマネをする。
blocks.translation: No — that’s because you’re weak. Weaklings act that way.

blocks.text: 笑止! 欲しいなら俺を倒せ・・・。 俺より強いことを示せ!
blocks.translation: Absurd! If you want it, defeat me... prove you’re stronger than I am!

blocks.text: そのつまらん理由が、 お前の弱さの秘密だ!
blocks.translation: That pathetic reason is the secret of your weakness!

blocks.text: これが俺の求める強さだ。 俺は力を手に入れる・・・世界を壊すために。
blocks.translation: This is the strength I seek. I will gain power... to destroy the world.

blocks.text: 沢芽市もユグドラシルも、森の侵略に怯えるただの弱者でしかない。
blocks.translation: Zawame City and Yggdrasil are merely weaklings trembling at the forest’s invasion.

blocks.text: 俺の未来で待っていろ。 そう長くはかからない。
blocks.translation: Wait in my future. It won’t take long.

blocks.text: 価値がないものを消し去る。 それが俺の戦いだ。
blocks.translation: Erase what has no worth. That is my fight.

blocks.text: ザック、貴様・・・!
blocks.translation: Zack, you...!

blocks.text: そうか、強くなったな、ザック!
blocks.translation: You’ve gotten stronger, Zack!

blocks.text: 83 ああ、分かってる・・・。
blocks.translation: 83 Ah, I understand...

blocks.text: そうだ。 守るものも失うものもなくなった俺は、もう誰にも負けることはない。
blocks.translation: That’s right. With nothing left to protect and nothing left to lose, I will no longer be defeated by anyone.

blocks.text: 俺が立ち向かうべき相手はより強い者。 このヘルヘイムという世界そのものだ。
blocks.translation: The opponent I must confront is something stronger — this world called Helheim itself.

blocks.text: 84 俺の行く末を見届けるんじゃないのか
blocks.translation: 84 Aren't you going to see where I end up?

blocks.text: より絶対的な力。 人間の限界を越えて世界そのものを屈服させる手段。
blocks.translation: A more absolute power. A means to exceed human limits and subjugate the world itself.

blocks.text: 耀子は耀子、知恵の実は知恵の実だ。
blocks.translation: Yoko is Yoko, and the Fruit of Wisdom is the Fruit of Wisdom.

blocks.text: その手がかりがこの森にはある。
blocks.translation: A clue to that is in this forest.

blocks.text: やはり最後まで俺の邪魔をするのはお前だったか。 葛葉紘汰。
blocks.translation: So it was you who got in my way until the very end. Kuzuha Kouta.

blocks.text: 102 やはりお前は強いな・・・。
blocks.translation: 102 You really are strong...

blocks.text: 103 葛葉、相変わらずだな。 貴様はまだそんな風にあがいているのか。
blocks.translation: 103 Kuzuha, still the same. Are you still writhing like that?

blocks.text: 台灣
blocks.translation: Taiwan

blocks.text: 台灣
blocks.translation: Taiwan

blocks.text: 今の人間では決して実現できない世界を、俺が、 この手で作り上げる。
blocks.translation: I will build, with these hands, a world that today's humans could never achieve.

blocks.text: なぜだ･･････なにがお前を、そこまで強くした・・・。
blocks.translation: Why... What made you become so strong...?

blocks.text: 者が踏みにじられない世界だ。誰かをげるためだけの力を求めない、そんな新しい命で、
blocks.translation: A world where people are never trampled. With a new life that doesn't seek power just to hurt someone,

blocks.text: なぜ泣く・・・。
blocks.translation: Why are you crying...?

blocks.text: この星を満たす。 と一緒に。 知恵の実を使って、
blocks.translation: I will fill this planet. Together with it. Using the fruit of wisdom,

blocks.text: お前は本当に強い!
blocks.translation: You really are strong!

blocks.text: それが俺の生きてきた時代だ。誰もが強くなるほど、優しさを忘れていった。
blocks.translation: That was the era I lived in. The more people became strong, the more they forgot kindness.

blocks.text: だが･･･いつかまた間違える。 再び争い、傷つけ合う。
blocks.translation: But... one day we will make mistakes again. We will fight and hurt each other again.

blocks.text: そんなヤツから先に死んでいった!優しさがアダになって、本当の強さに至れなかった。貴様もそうだ。葛葉紘汰。
blocks.translation: Those kinds of people were the first to die! Kindness became a liability, and they couldn't reach true strength. The same goes for you. Kuzuha Kouta.

blocks.text: それでいい! その運命を決めるにふさわしい!
blocks.translation: That's fine! You are fit to decide that fate!

blocks.text: そうだ!弱さに痛みしか与えない世界、強くなるしか他になかった世界を俺は憎んだ!
blocks.translation: Exactly! I hated a world where weakness only brought pain, a world where the only option was to grow stronger!

blocks.text: 今、その全てを滅ぼす力に手が届く!を超えた先に!
blocks.translation: Now, the power to destroy all of that is within reach! Beyond it!

blocks.text: その程度か･･･!
blocks.translation: Is that all...!?

blocks.text: ぬあーあ! 来い!
blocks.translation: Nuaaah! Come!

blocks.text: どうした…後がないぞ!
blocks.translation: What's the matter... There's no backing out now!

blocks.text: これで終わりだ!!
blocks.translation: This ends now!!

blocks.text: 104 俺のやることは変わらない。 変身!
blocks.translation: 104 What I do does not change. Transform!

blocks.text: 105 ひとつになるだと? くだらん。 そんな弱い考えを持つ者など、俺の手で倒す。
blocks.translation: 105 Become one, you say? Ridiculous. I will crush anyone who holds such weak ideas.

blocks.text:
106 俺に勝って手に入れた未来だ。 意地でも守れ!
107 当たり前だ。 お前に分かってたまるか
108 なんだ。
109 お前ならもっと強くなる。 そう思っただけだ。
110 いいだろう。
blocks.translation:
106 The future you took by beating me — protect it at all costs!
107 Of course. As if I'd ever let you understand.
108 What?
109 I just thought you'd grow even stronger.
110 Fine.

blocks.translation: Dialogue

blocks.text: 誰かのために傷つくことが、 そんなにおかしいことなんですか?
blocks.translation: Is it really so strange to get hurt for someone else?

blocks.text: 紘汰さん、せめて僕達で、 舞さんの笑顔だけは守りましょ。
blocks.translation: Kouta, at least let us protect Mai's smile.

blocks.text: 僕、紘汰さんが間違ってたなんて思えない。 そんなふうに悲しんだら、
blocks.translation: I can't bring myself to believe Kouta was wrong. If you grieve like that,

blocks.text: 本当に紘汰さんのやってきたことがなんだったのか、分からなくなっちゃいますよ。
blocks.translation: you'll lose sight of what Kouta has really been doing.

blocks.text:
世の中には平気で人を傷つける人がいる。 目的のためなら何でも犠牲にできる人たちがいる。
真実っていうのは! そういう連中のためのものなんですよ。
blocks.translation: There are people in this world who hurt others without a second thought. There are those who can sacrifice anything to achieve their goals. Truth belongs to people like that!

blocks.text: 紘汰さんは必ず立ち直るって、信じてます。 あの人は、なにも間違ったことなんてしてないんです。
blocks.translation: I believe Kouta will recover. He hasn't done anything wrong.

blocks.text: 僕だって変わりたい。 こんな自分は嫌なんだ。 でも、僕にできることなんてあるのか?
blocks.translation: I want to change too. I hate being like this. But is there anything I can actually do?

blocks.text:
紘汰さんはもう十分に傷つきました。 これ以上戦う必要なんてない。 この先ヘルヘイムの侵食が
進んでも、ユグドラシルがなにを計画しても、みんなは必ず僕が守ります。 信じてください。
blocks.translation: Kouta has already been hurt enough. There's no need for him to fight anymore. No matter how far Helheim's corruption spreads, whatever Yggdrasil plans, I will protect everyone. Please believe me.

blocks.text: 紘汰さんの留守なら勝てると思ったかい? あいにくだけど・・・そう簡単にはやらせない!
blocks.translation: Did you think you could win while Kouta was away? Unfortunately... I won't let you have it that easily!

blocks.text: どうしてアナタは･･･ 素直に僕に従ってくれないんです?
blocks.translation: Why won't you just follow me honestly?

blocks.text: つらいこと、悲しいこと、決して消えてなくなったりしない。
blocks.translation: Painful things and sad things never simply disappear.

blocks.text: ねえ、 キミは10年後の自分がどうなってるか想像できる? どんな運命を辿ってるのか、
blocks.translation: Hey, can you picture yourself ten years from now? What fate will you be following?

blocks.text: 大切な人が傷つくよりも、 自分が傷ついた方がいい。 そうだよね。 紘汰さん。
blocks.translation: It's better to be hurt yourself than to hurt someone you care about. Isn't that right, Kouta?

blocks.text: どんな力にだって危険は伴う。 分かってます。 それでも覚悟の上です。
blocks.translation: Every power carries risks. I know that. Even so, I'm prepared.

blocks.text:
自分の力でどうにかなるとでも? 分かるはずないよね。 いいんだ。 その方が幸せだよ。
本当に大事なのはね、 誰に与え、 誰から奪うのか、それを決められる立場に立つことなんだ。
blocks.translation:
Do you really think you can fix things with your own strength? You couldn't possibly understand. That's okay — you'll be happier that way.
What's truly important is being in a position to decide who to give to and who to take from.

blocks.text: ねえ紘汰さん。 あなたには分からないかもしれない。 なんのしがらみもなく、
blocks.translation: Hey, Kouta. You might not understand. Without any ties,

blocks.text: それが権力。 僕の求めていた、力。
blocks.translation: that is power. The power I sought.

blocks.text: 自分の人生を歩んできたあなたには。 それがどれほど幸せなことか。
blocks.translation: For someone like you who has lived your life your own way, you probably don't know how fortunate that is.

blocks.text: 紘汰さん、 あなた騙されてるだけじゃないですか?
blocks.translation: Kouta, aren't you just being deceived?

blocks.text: 僕はいつも進む道を人に決められて、 ただ流されてばっかりで、
blocks.translation: I've always had the path I take decided by others — I've just been swept along.

blocks.text: そうやって簡単に利用されるから! あなたは裕也さんのことを!
blocks.translation: That's why you get used so easily! You, about Yuya...!

blocks.text:
そんな自分が嫌で仕方なかった。 でもこのベルトを手に入れて、はじめて自分の意志で
選んだ戦いをすることができたんです。 これは僕にとって宝物なんですよ。
blocks.translation: I hated that side of me. But when I got this belt, for the first time I could choose the fight with my own will. This is a treasure to me.

blocks.text: 紘汰さん、そうやって、 また取り返しのつかないことになるかもしれないんですよ?
blocks.translation: Kouta, if you go on like that you might end up causing something irreparable again, you know?

blocks.text: 僕の言うことなんてなにも聞いてくれないくせに。
blocks.translation: You never listen to anything I say.

blocks.text: ダメだ紘汰さん! あなたにはもう、戦う理由なんてない!
blocks.translation: No, Kouta! You have no reason left to fight!

blocks.text: この人は、もっと痛い目にあわないと分からないっていうのか...。
blocks.translation: Are you saying this guy won't understand unless he goes through more pain...?

blocks.text: 僕だって勝算なんかありません! でも、歯向かうよりももっと簡単で、
blocks.translation: I don't have any chance of winning either! But it's easier than fighting back,

blocks.text: 紘汰さん、どうして喋った?
blocks.translation: Kouta, why did you speak?

blocks.text: 確実にユグドラシルを困らせる方法なら、 今すぐにでも思いつきます。
blocks.translation: I can think of a surefire way to cause trouble for Yggdrasil right now.

blocks.text: 僕はただ、 舞さんに笑顔でいてほしいだけなのに。 どうしてこんなことに...。
blocks.translation: I just want Mai to keep smiling. Why did it end up like this...?

blocks.text:
捨てちゃうんですよ! そのベルト! ヤツらは僕たちがベルトを手放さないと思い込んでる。
だからそれを壊すか捨てるかすれば、少なくとも紘汰さんだけは、ヤツらの悪巧みから
blocks.translation:
Throw it away! That belt! They assume we won't let go of the belt.
So if we break it or throw it away, at least Kouta will be safe from their schemes.

blocks.text: 紘汰さん・・・全部あなたのせいだ! もう何もかも滅茶苦茶だ!
blocks.translation: Kouta... it's all your fault! Everything's a mess!

blocks.text: それもこれも、 あなたが舞さんを巻き込むから!
blocks.translation: None of this would have happened if you hadn't dragged Mai into it!

blocks.text: 抜け出すことができます。
blocks.translation: You can escape it.

blocks.text: 紘汰さん! 舞さんを悲しませるあなたに! もうヒーローの資格なんてない!
blocks.translation: Kouta! For making Mai sad — you no longer deserve to be a hero!

blocks.text: 隠し事をしたり! 舞さんに心配をかける必要もなくなる。
blocks.translation: No more secrets! No need to make Mai worry.

blocks.text: 葛葉紘汰･･･ アイツが二度と戻らなければ…。
blocks.translation: 葛葉紘汰... If only he never returned...

blocks.text: 紘汰さんみたいな人にとっては、 それが一番の選択かもしれません。
blocks.translation: For someone like Kouta, that might be the best option.
Now...

blocks.text: 紘汰さん! 言ったはずです!変身すれば、 ユグドラシルの連中の思うツボだって!
blocks.translation: Kouta! I told you! If you transform, you'll be right in Yggdrasil's trap!

blocks.text: やった･･･!
blocks.translation: I did it...!

blocks.text: 紘汰さん!! あなたって人は・・・。
blocks.translation: Kouta!! What kind of person are you...

blocks.text: 何をする!
blocks.translation: What are you doing!

blocks.text: 守りたいもの?
blocks.translation: Something you want to protect?

blocks.text: お前には関係ない!
blocks.translation: None of your business!

blocks.text: 紘汰さんや・・・舞さんと・・・ 笑顔で楽しく過ごせる時間。 それだけはいつまでも変わらずに
blocks.translation: The time I can spend with Kouta and Mai, smiling and having fun — I want that never to change.

blocks.text: そいつを放っておけば、 アンタの邪魔をし続ける。 ここでトドメを刺した方が、 アンタの為にもなるはずだ!
blocks.translation: If you leave him be, he'll keep getting in your way. Finishing him off now would even be for your own good!

blocks.text: あってほしいです。 たとえ僕が、 どんなに変わっていたとしても。
blocks.translation: I want that to be true. Even if I've changed beyond recognition.

blocks.text: そうだね。 紘汰さんのせいだ。 紘汰さんに関わるとみんなおかしくなってしまう。 あの人は、危険だ。
blocks.translation: That's right. It's Kouta's fault. Anyone who gets involved with him goes strange. He's dangerous.

blocks.text: 呉島家の次男として、ユグドラシルで働くにあたって求められる力ってなんだろうね?
blocks.translation: As the Kureshima family's second son, what kind of strengths are required to work at Yggdrasil, I wonder?

blocks.text: 世界を救うために舞さんを犠牲にするっていうのか。 バカな。
blocks.translation: Are you going to sacrifice Mai to save the world? Ridiculous.

blocks.text:
ただの腕っぷしの強さ・・・違うよね。 僕が見せなきゃならないのは、人を操り、従わせる手際!
それが兄さんの望んでる才能だ。
blocks.translation: It's not just brute strength... My show of skill has to be manipulating people and making them obey! That's the talent my brother wants.

blocks.text:
ねえ舞さん、そんな顔しないでよ。 もっと昔みたいな顔してよ! なんでだろう。 思い出せないや。
あなた、 昔はどんな顔してたっけ・・・。 僕は、なにを守ろうとして、なんのために戦ってたんだっけ?
blocks.translation: Hey Mai, don't make that face. Smile like you used to! Why is that... I can't remember. What did you look like back then...? What was I trying to protect, and why was I fighting?

blocks.text: 紘汰さん…冷静に考えてくださいね。 なにが一番賢い行動か。
blocks.translation: Kouta... think this through calmly. What is the smartest course of action?

blocks.text: それでもあなたは、僕にとって最後の光だ。 あなたのためになら、こんな命、 投げ捨てたって構わない。
blocks.translation: Even so, you are my last light. For you, I don't mind throwing away my life.

blocks.text: 黙ってろ。
blocks.translation: Shut up.

blocks.text: もう黙っててくれよ。
blocks.translation: Just be quiet already.

blocks.text: 使えないヤツ・・・。
blocks.translation: Useless...

blocks.text: 葛葉紘汰、 あなたはこの僕が止める。
blocks.translation: Kuzuha Kouta, I will stop you.

blocks.text: 使い方次第で、きっとあなたの野心の切り札にできますよ。 僕は。
blocks.translation: Used the right way, it can surely be the trump card for your ambitions. I can be that.

blocks.text: 結局、 僕は何も勝ち取ることができなかった。 それでもあの人だけは･･･。
blocks.translation: In the end, I didn't win anything. But that person...

blocks.text: よかった。 これでまた、みんなと一緒にいられる。 舞さん、紘汰さん。
blocks.translation: I'm glad. Now I can be with everyone again. Mai, Kouta.

blocks.text: 舞さんだけは、なんとしても守り抜いてみせる。 そのためなら、僕の命なんか･･･。
blocks.translation: I'll protect only Mai no matter what. For that, I would even give my life...

blocks.text: この笑顔を見ていられるなら・・・ 僕は、どんなことだってできる
blocks.translation: If I can keep seeing this smile... I can do anything.

blocks.text: 舞さんは?
blocks.translation: What about Mai?

blocks.text: この幸せが守れるなら、僕は、どんな裏切りだってできる。
blocks.translation: If I can protect this happiness, I can commit any betrayal.

blocks.text: アンタは･･･舞さんを救うって!
blocks.translation: You're... going to save Mai!

blocks.text: これでいいんだ。 真実をすべて隠しておけば、みんなの笑顔を守り通せる。
blocks.translation: This is fine. If I hide the whole truth, I can keep protecting everyone's smiles.

blocks.text: 僕は、一生懸命やったのに・・・。
blocks.translation: I did my best...

blocks.text: 裕也さんのこと、舞さんに話すつもりだったんですか?
blocks.translation: Were you planning to tell Mai about Yuya?

blocks.text: 58 貴様ー!
blocks.translation: 58 You!

blocks.text: 教えられるわけないでしょ! 僕は紘汰さんに笑顔でいて欲しかった。
blocks.translation: There's no way I could tell her! I wanted Kouta to keep smiling.

blocks.text: うううつ・・・うわああああっ･･･。 ううわあああっ!!
blocks.translation: Uuu... uwaaaah... uwaaaah!!

blocks.text: それを台無しにするようなことは、たとえ真実であろうと! 許せなかった。
blocks.translation: I couldn't allow anything that would ruin it, even if it were the truth!

blocks.text: 僕には、そんな資格なんてないよ・・・。
blocks.translation: I don't have the qualifications for that...

blocks.text:
今もそう思っています。 紘汰さんには最後まで知らないままでいて欲しかった。
紘汰さん、この事は舞さんに話すべきじゃない。
blocks.translation:
I still think that. I wanted Kouta to remain unaware until the very end.
Kouta, you shouldn't tell Mai about this.

blocks.text: 兄さん･･･僕は･･･どうすれば…。
blocks.translation: Brother... what should I do...?
...Brother...

blocks.text: 台同
blocks.translation: Taitong

blocks.text: 台同
blocks.translation: Taitong

blocks.text: コウガネ･･･誰だ!?
blocks.translation: Kogane... who is that?!

blocks.text: みんな!
blocks.translation: Everyone!

blocks.text: まだ残ってるロックシードはあるんだよ。
blocks.translation: There are still Lockseeds left.

blocks.text: 紘汰さんをどうした!!
blocks.translation: What did you do to Kouta?!

blocks.text: 確かにあの人はヒーローだった。 でも、もう紘汰さんはいない。
blocks.translation: He was certainly a hero. But Kouta is no longer here.

blocks.text: これはさんからのメッセージ･･･聞こえますか!さん!
blocks.translation: This is a message from... Can you hear me?!

blocks.text: だから僕たちが、ヒーローにならなきゃいけないんだ!
blocks.translation: That's why we have to become heroes!

blocks.text: 舞さん! 絶対に助けます! それが僕にできる、唯一の償いなんだ!
blocks.translation: Mai! I'll definitely save you! It's the only atonement I can offer!

blocks.text: 見ていてください、紘汰さん。 今度こそ、みんなを守ってみせます!
blocks.translation: Please watch over me, Kouta. This time, I'll protect everyone!

blocks.text: 舞さん! 舞さん!大丈夫ですか! 舞さん! 舞さん!さん!
blocks.translation: Mai! Mai! Are you okay?! Mai! Mai!

blocks.text: すみません、紘汰さん。 やっぱり僕は、何もやり遂げることができませんでした。
blocks.translation: I'm sorry, Kouta. In the end, I couldn't accomplish anything.

blocks.text: よかった... 今度こそ、助けることができた...。
blocks.translation: Thank goodness... This time I was able to help...

blocks.text: 68 紘汰さん・・・!
blocks.translation: 68 Kouta-san...!

blocks.text: 兄さん! これを!
blocks.translation: Brother! Take this!

blocks.text: はい、紘汰さん。
blocks.translation: Yes, Kouta.

blocks.text: 僕達は確かに無軌道だ。 それぞれの思いでバラバラに動く。 だから失敗もする!
blocks.translation: We are certainly reckless. We each act according to our own feelings. That's why we fail!

blocks.text: 待ってください! 紘汰さんに伝えたいこと、たくさんあるんです!
blocks.translation: Please wait! There are so many things I want to tell Kouta!

blocks.text: 紘汰さんと舞さんの考えなんか、最初からお見通しです。 だって僕たち・・・チームじゃないですか。
blocks.translation: I've seen through what Kouta and Mai were thinking from the start. After all, we're a team, aren't we?

blocks.text: うつうつうう・・うわああああああああっ!あああああああっ!
blocks.translation: Uuu... uu... Uwaaaaaah! Aaaaah!

blocks.text: なに!?
blocks.translation: What?!

blocks.text: 自分の命だからって、 惜しむものか!
blocks.translation: Just because it's your own life—are you going to hold back?!

blocks.text: アンタ・・・わざと・・・。
blocks.translation: You... did that on purpose...

blocks.text:
僕にはなにも残されていない… もう舞さんだけなんだ! 舞さんだけは、
失うわけにはいかないんだ!
blocks.translation: I have nothing left... Only Mai remains! I cannot lose Mai!

blocks.text: 違う! 僕は・・・。

blocks.text: 引き返すなんて・・・。 無理だ・・・。
blocks.translation: Turning back... impossible...

blocks.text: うるさい!
blocks.translation: Shut up!

blocks.text: そんな理由で、僕を許すっていうのか?
blocks.translation: Are you going to forgive me for that reason?

blocks.text: それでアンタが止められるなら、喜んで死んでやる!
blocks.translation: If that'll stop you, I'll gladly die!

blocks.text: 許せるかよ･･･。 許される訳無いだろ! ・・・こんなんじゃ僕は・・・何一つ・・・。
blocks.translation: Can I forgive you...? There's no way you'll be forgiven! If things stay like this, I'll be left with nothing...

blocks.text: 舞さん... 振り向いてくれなくてもいい。 もう二度と会えなくなったとしても。
blocks.translation: Mai... It's fine if you don't turn to look at me. Even if we never meet again.

blocks.text: いや、まだだ。 まだ残ってる。 せめて、せめて舞さんだけはこの手で救う。
blocks.translation: No, not yet. There's still something left. At the very least, I'll save Mai with my own hands.

blocks.text: 葛葉紘汰!アンタに渡すぐらいなら!
blocks.translation: Kuzuha Kouta! If I were to give it to you...

blocks.text: それができたら、こんな僕でも、アンタに許されるだけの価値があったと思えるよ。 紘汰さん。
blocks.translation: If I could do that, even someone like me would feel I deserve your forgiveness, Kouta.

blocks.text: 台詞
blocks.translation: Lines

blocks.text: 私だ。
blocks.translation: It's me.

blocks.text: そうだ。 光実を追い詰めたのは、俺だ。
blocks.translation: That's right. I'm the one who cornered Mitsuzane.

blocks.text:
懐かしいな。 お前がそのドライバーを使うのは久しぶりだ。 よく二人で無茶をしたもんだ。
なにを言ってる。 これからもそれは変わらない。
blocks.translation: How nostalgic. It's been a while since you used that Driver. We used to do reckless things together. What are you saying? That won't change from now on.

blocks.text:
あの頃からお前は、 ずっと俺のことが許せなかったんだな。 お前を理解してやれなかった兄が。
決着をつけよう。 光実。
blocks.translation: Ever since then, you couldn't forgive me. Your brother couldn't understand you. Let's settle this, Mitsuzane.

blocks.text: 手強いな。 だが!
blocks.translation: You're formidable. But!

blocks.text: 俺には最後のつとめが残っている。 この手で、 お前を止めなくてはならん。
blocks.translation: I have one final duty left. With these hands, I must stop you.

blocks.text: そうだ。 俺とお前で造り上げた、 戦極ドライバーが負けるはずもない!
blocks.translation: That's right. The Sengoku Driver that you and I created cannot possibly lose!

blocks.text: そうか･･･それが、俺から学んだ結論か。
blocks.translation: I see... Is that the conclusion you learned from me?

blocks.text: なにを言う。お前の力があればこそだ。
blocks.translation: What are you saying? It's precisely because of your power.

blocks.text: お前は俺の形だ。 俺の犯してきた過ちの全てだ。
blocks.translation: You are my form — the sum of all the mistakes I've made.

blocks.text: どうした? その程度か?
blocks.translation: What's wrong? Is that all you've got?

blocks.text: そうだな。 だからこそ、 お前はここで終わる。
blocks.translation: That's right. That's why you end here.

blocks.text: 逃げるな。 さあかかってこい。
blocks.translation: Don't run. Come at me.

blocks.text: なぜ俺の影ばかりを引き受けた! 俺よりも輝くはずの才能を持っておきながら!
blocks.translation: Why did you always take on my shadow?! You have talents that should shine brighter than mine!

blocks.text: 何故、だと? 敵に何故などと問いかける者は、 そもそも戦う資格すらない!
blocks.translation: Why, you ask? Those who ask 'why' of the enemy aren't even qualified to fight!

blocks.text: その通りだ!
blocks.translation: Exactly!

blocks.text: そのベルトは過ぎた力だ。 手放してもらおう。
blocks.translation: That belt is an excessive power. Hand it over.

blocks.text: 光実!
blocks.translation: Mitsuzane!

blocks.text: 戦いに意味を求めてどうする? 答えを探しだすより先に、死が訪れるだけのこと。
blocks.translation: What's the use of seeking meaning in battle? Death will come before you find the answer.

blocks.text: 光実、 これが、お前の求めていたものなのか?
blocks.translation: Mitsuzane, is this what you were seeking?

blocks.text:
この世界には理由のない悪意などいくらでも転がっている。 そんなことさえ気づかずに
今日まで生きてきたのなら、貴様の命にも意味はない。 今、この場で消えるがいい!
blocks.translation: There is no shortage of senseless malice in this world. If you've lived until today without noticing that, then your life has no meaning. Disappear here and now!

blocks.text: ここは、一体・・・。葛葉･･･紘汰・・・。
blocks.translation: Where is this...? Kuzuha... Kouta...

blocks.text: そうか、もう何もかも終わったんだな。どおりで、安らかな気分なわけだ。
blocks.translation: I see — everything's already over. No wonder I feel so at peace.

blocks.text: 俺がやる。 このプロジェクトを引き受けた責任に、 背を向けるつもりはない。
blocks.translation: I'll do it. I won't turn my back on the responsibility of taking on this project.

blocks.text: もう楽になってもいい・・・ そうなんだろう?
blocks.translation: It's okay to rest now... isn't it?

blocks.text:
今や世界の命運はユグドラシルに託されているも同然だ。 俺は、人類の未来を切り開く。
目的はアーマードライダーの強制送還。 お前達はサポートだ。 ヤツらは俺がやる。
blocks.translation: The fate of the world is now practically entrusted to Yggdrasil. I will carve out humanity's future. The objective is the forced return of the Armored Riders. You will be support; I'll handle them.

blocks.text: この期に及んでか。 私に、何をしろと?
blocks.translation: At this point? What do you want me to do?

blocks.text: あいつが、私の言葉を聞き届けるだろうか。
blocks.translation: Will he heed my words?

blocks.text: それは、私にもできなかったことだ。
blocks.translation: That's something I couldn't do either.

blocks.text: この森であまりはしゃいでもらっては困る。
blocks.translation: Don't get too excited in this forest.

blocks.text: 葛葉･･･。 そうか･･･ 確かに難題だな。
blocks.translation: Kuzuha... I see... It really is a difficult problem.

blocks.text: 終わりだ!
blocks.translation: It's over!

blocks.text: うるさい。
blocks.translation: Be quiet.

blocks.text: フッ。
blocks.translation: Hmph.

blocks.text: 貴様を相手にしてる時間などない!
blocks.translation: I don't have time to deal with you!

blocks.text: もう、キミたちを巻き込むわけにはいかない。 これは、私の罪滅ぼしでもあるんだ。
blocks.translation: I can't involve you all anymore. This is also my atonement.

blocks.text: ああ、 初瀬亮二はインベスになって、ユグドラシルに処分された。
blocks.translation: Ah — Hatsuse Ryoji became an Inves and was disposed of by Yggdrasil.

blocks.text: どけぇ!
blocks.translation: Get out of the way!

blocks.text: 葛葉なら、こんな時でも、決して諦めないはずだ。 私も変わってみせる。 人類を救ってみせる。
blocks.translation: If it's Kuzuha, he would never give up even now. I'll change too. I'll save humanity.

blocks.text: な、しまった!
blocks.translation: Oh no!

blocks.text: 宇宙キ!・・・タと言っておいてやるか･･･。
blocks.translation: …(garbled)

blocks.text: 決着をつけよう。 凌馬。
blocks.translation: Let's settle this, Ryoma.

blocks.text: ここは･･･? お前たちは、何者なんだ?
blocks.translation: Where is this...? Who are you people?

blocks.text: 光実! 凌馬の相手は任せろ!
blocks.translation: Mitsuzane! Leave Ryoma to me!

blocks.text: 森に、選ばれただと? お前たちは、侵略に打ち勝ったのではないのか?
blocks.translation: Chosen by the forest? Didn't you overcome the invasion?

blocks.text: 行くんだ!お前には、やるべきものがあるんだろ!
blocks.translation: Go! You have something you must do!

blocks.text: 誰もが強さを求めたゆえに、誰も破滅を止められなかった･･･。 それが、 お前たちの結論なのか?
blocks.translation: Because everyone sought strength, no one could stop the destruction... Is that your conclusion?

blocks.text: フッ･･･それはどうかな。 ハッ!
blocks.translation: Heh... I wonder about that. Hah!

blocks.text: ユグドラシルは、世界を守ることができなかったのか･･･。 俺たちは一体・・・ 何のために...。
blocks.translation: Was Yggdrasil unable to protect the world...? What on earth were we for...?

blocks.text: バカはお前だ･･･凌馬。 お前の語る神など、 意味の無い、 空っぽの存在に過ぎない。
blocks.translation: You're the fool, Ryoma. The god you speak of is nothing but an empty, meaningless thing.

blocks.text: そしてメガヘクスの奴隷に成り下がった今、お前自身が、 空っぽになってしまったんだ!
blocks.translation: And now that you've become a slave to Megahex, you yourself have become empty!

blocks.text: 光実がなぜ、俺のベルトを...?
blocks.translation: Why did Mitsuzane take my belt...?

blocks.text: やめろ! 実
blocks.translation: Stop it!

blocks.text: そうだな。 終わりにしよう。
blocks.translation: Yeah. Let's end this.

blocks.text: 光実、なぜ葛葉を襲ったりする? お前はそんなことをする男じゃない筈だ! 光実!
blocks.translation: Mitsuzane, why would you attack Kuzuha? You're not the kind of man to do that! Mitsuzane!

blocks.text: はああああああああっ!ハァーーーッ!!
blocks.translation: Haaaaaah! Haaaaah!

blocks.text: バカな・・・。 光実がなぜ...。
blocks.translation: No... It can't be. Mitsuzane... why...?

blocks.text: お別れだな。･･･
blocks.translation: So this is goodbye...

blocks.text: 過去の経緯がどうであれ、 今は人間同士で争ってる場合ではない。
blocks.translation: Regardless of what happened in the past, now is not the time for humans to be fighting each other.

blocks.text: まだだ･･･まだ俺は･･･諦めるわけにはいかない...
blocks.translation: No... I can't give up yet...

blocks.text: 力を合わせてオーバーロードに立ち向かうというなら、キミもまた、貴重な味方だ。
blocks.translation: If we're going to join forces to stand against the Overlord, you too will be a valuable ally.

blocks.text: お前の負けだ葛葉。 付き合え。 別れを惜しむくらいの時間はあるだろう。
blocks.translation: You've lost, Kuzuha. Come with me. There should be time to say goodbye.

blocks.text: 敵、そう判断するしかない。 たとえ血を分けた肉親であっても。
blocks.translation: Enemy. We have no choice but to treat them as such — even if they're of our own blood.
Kuzuha...

blocks.text:
トルキア共和国。 8年振りか。 この国に住む90%は地下世界の住人。 ノブレス・オブリージュ。 私はまだ、この
国で成すべきことがある。 すまないな雅仁。 俺はまだ死ねない。 今の俺を、 お前は許してくれるだろうか。
blocks.translation: Republic of Turkia. It's been eight years. Ninety percent of the people who live in this country are inhabitants of the underground world. Noblesse Oblige. I still have things to accomplish here. Sorry, Masahito. I can't die yet. Will you forgive me as I am now?

blocks.translation: Lines

blocks.text: 台詞
blocks.translation: Lines

blocks.text: ここはどこだ。 俺は一体。
blocks.translation: Where is this place? Who am I?

blocks.text: 悪意は断ち切ればいい! 何度でもだ!
blocks.translation: Cut off malice! Over and over!

blocks.text: 俺は・・・あいつのことを知っている･･･アーマードライダー・・・新月!
blocks.translation: I... I know him... Armored Rider... Zangetsu!

blocks.text: それがお前の手に入れた力か。 これで分かった。 お前は何も変わってない!
blocks.translation: So that's the power you've gained. Now I understand. You haven't changed at all!

blocks.text: ひとついいか。 その、おっさんというのはやめろ。 俺はおそらくそんな年ではない。
blocks.translation: Let me just say this: Um, stop calling me an old man. I'm probably not that old.

blocks.text: 変わってない! 変わったのは、この俺だ!
blocks.translation: Nothing has changed! It's me who has changed!

blocks.text: 好きに呼べ。・・・俺はそんな年ではない･･･ はずだ・・・。
blocks.translation: Call me what you like... I'm not that old... I shouldn't be...

blocks.text: ああ、俺は変わった。 戦いの中で、俺はたくさんの奴に出会った。
blocks.translation: Yes, I've changed. In battle, I've met many people.

blocks.text: アイムを連れて早くいけ! その体でなにができる?
blocks.translation: Take Aim and go quickly! What can you do with that body?

blocks.text: そこで俺は、自分の弱さを知った。 そう、弱さだ。 ノブレス・オブリージュ。 これまでの俺は、
blocks.translation: There I learned my own weakness. Yes — weakness. Noblesse Oblige. Until now, I...

blocks.text: すべての大人が、 お前が思ってるような奴じゃないということを教えてやる。 行け。
blocks.translation: I'll show you that not all adults are the kind of people you think. Go.

blocks.text: 一人で自らの責務を果たそうと必死だった。 だが、 自分の弱さゆえに成すことが出来なかった。
blocks.translation: I desperately tried to fulfill my duty alone. But because of my weakness, I could not accomplish it.

blocks.text: 私に・・・何か隠していることはないか。・・・いいから答えろ。···お前は誰だ!
blocks.translation: Are you hiding something from me? ...Just answer. ...Who are you!?

blocks.text: 影正･･･。 わかった...。
blocks.translation: Kagemasa... I understand...

blocks.text: あいつは正・・・ 雅仁の弟だ･･･。 何故私を殺そうとする。
blocks.translation: He is Kagemasa... Masahito's younger brother... Why would he try to kill me?

blocks.text: いくぞ雅仁、決着を付けよう!
blocks.translation: Come on, Masahito — let's settle this!

blocks.text: 殺したければ殺せ･･･だが、私はまだ死ねない。 雅仁との約束を果たすまでは。
blocks.translation: Kill me if you want... but I cannot die yet. Not until I fulfill my promise to Masahito.

blocks.text: それでも、俺は、負けるわけにはいかない!
blocks.translation: Even so, I must not lose!

blocks.text: 私が世界を救った・・・いや違う･･･世界を救ったのは私ではない。 ･･･ 世界を救ったのは・・・。
blocks.translation: I saved the world... No, that's wrong... It wasn't I who saved the world. The one who saved the world was...

blocks.text: お前の行為は、人類に対する裏切りに等しい! 信じろ! 人間はそこまで愚かではない。
blocks.translation: Your actions amount to a betrayal of humanity! Believe me — humanity is not that foolish.

blocks.text: 世界を救ったのは、 葛葉紘汰。 私は変われなかった。
blocks.translation: The one who saved the world was Kouta Kazuraba. I could not change.

blocks.text: 弱い。 だが弱いからこそ強くなれる。 だれかを信じることができる!
blocks.translation: Weak. But it is because we are weak that we can become strong. We can trust someone!
Masahito...

blocks.text: うっ･･･まだだ･･･。 うわああああああっ! はああああああああっ!
blocks.translation: Ugh... not yet... Uwaaaaah! Haaaaaa!

blocks.text: 王だと･･･。 俺との約束は。
blocks.translation: A king... and our promise.

blocks.text: お前との約束だ･･･。 俺は、お前との約束を果たすために··· お前を倒す。
blocks.translation: It's a promise with you... I will fulfill our promise... by defeating you.

blocks.text: そうだ･･･それが俺達の誇りでは無かったのか。 変わったな、 雅仁。
blocks.translation: That's right... wasn't that our pride? You've changed, Masahito.

blocks.text: 世界を守る責務を果たす。
blocks.translation: I will fulfill the duty to protect the world.

blocks.text:
泣くな。お前にはまだやるべきことがある。 すべてのチームをまとめろ。 貴族に反旗を翻せ!
私は罪を償うためにこの国にやってきた! だから戦う。 それ以外に、私が罪を償える方法は無い。
生きる意味が無いと言ったな! 生きることでしか、罪に抗えない。
blocks.translation: Don't cry. You still have things to do. Unite all the teams. Rise up against the nobles! I came to this country to atone for my sins! That's why I fight. There is no other way for me to atone. You said life has no meaning — but only by living can you oppose your sins.

blocks.text: 俺の勝ちだ。
blocks.translation: I win.

blocks.text: それが、死んでいった者たちへの、唯一の手向けだ!
blocks.translation: That is the only tribute to those who have died!

blocks.text:
お前は一人だ。 だが、俺は一人ではなかった。 俺は、こいつらのことを信じてる。
影正も、これまで戦ってきたすべての人間。 そして・・・今でもお前の事を信じてる。
俺はすべての人の思いを背負って戦った。 誰かを信じて共に歩む。
blocks.translation: You're alone. But I was not. I believe in these people — Kagemasa and everyone I've fought with. And even now, I believe in you. I fought carrying everyone's hopes. Trust someone and walk together.

blocks.text: アイム、 そっくりだ。 私の知っている男に。 ・・・私に、変身しろと言った男だ。
blocks.translation: Aim — he's the spitting image of the man I know... the man who told me to transform.

blocks.text: それが...それが私のノブレス・オブリージュ。 それが私の変身だ。
blocks.translation: That... that is my noblesse oblige. That is my transformation.

blocks.text: もしかして・・・葛葉紘汰か? ･･･私はまだ、変身できないようだ。
blocks.translation: Could it be... Kouta Kazuraba? ...It seems I still can't transform.

blocks.text: ああ、お前の思いは、俺の中で生き続ける。
blocks.translation: Yes — your resolve lives on within me.

blocks.text: お前と出会う前から、 8年前から私は何も変われていない。
blocks.translation: I've been unchanged for eight years, even before I met you.

blocks.text: 任せてくれ。 さらばだ、 我が友よ。
blocks.translation: Leave it to me. Farewell, my friend.

blocks.text: あいつには偉そうなことを言ったが、 また雅仁に会ったら、 本当に戦えるかどうか･･･。
blocks.translation: I said lofty things to him, but if I meet Masahito again, whether I can really fight him...

blocks.text: 離れていても、私はお前たちと戦ったことを忘れない。
blocks.translation: Even when apart, I will not forget that I fought with you.

blocks.text: これは...。
blocks.translation: This is...

blocks.text: 私は戦い続ける。 この世界の歪みが無くなるまで。 それが私の償いだ。
blocks.translation: I will continue to fight until the distortions in this world are gone. That is my atonement.

blocks.text: 俺は変わった･･･か。
blocks.translation: Have I changed...?

blocks.text: 黒幕は貴様だな。
blocks.translation: You're the mastermind, aren't you?

blocks.text: ああ、自分の罪と向き合うために。 アイム、 お前はお前の戦いをしろ。 明日を掴むために。
blocks.translation: Yes — to face my own sins. Aim, you fight your fight. Seize tomorrow.

blocks.text: 無論。 始末をつけさせてもらう。
blocks.translation: Of course. I'll put an end to it.

blocks.text: お前に来いと言われて断る理由は無い。 俺とお前は、 同じ未来を見てたはずだ。
blocks.translation: There's no reason to refuse when you tell me to come. You and I were surely looking toward the same future.

blocks.text: お前の野望はここで絶たれる。
blocks.translation: Your ambition ends here.

blocks.text: 力を持つ者として生まれ、共に責務を果たすと。
blocks.translation: Born with power, we will fulfill our responsibilities together.

blocks.text: 言われるまでもない。 初めからそのつもりだ。
blocks.translation: No need to be told. That was my intention from the beginning.

blocks.text: 本当にやるつもりかい? 初瀬ちゃん? ま、 止めないけどさ。
blocks.translation: Are you really going to do it, Hatsuse-chan? Well, I won't stop you.

blocks.text: そうでしょう? 文句があんなら最初からルールで禁止にしときなって。
blocks.translation: Isn't that right? If you have complaints, then ban it by rule from the start.

blocks.text: 策士と呼んでほしいもんだな。
blocks.translation: I'd like to be called a strategist.

blocks.text: もうびっくりさせんなよー。 ･･･え? なにこれ。 ひょっとして、いきなりやられちゃったの?
blocks.translation: Don't surprise me like that. ...Huh? What's this? Did I get taken out suddenly?

blocks.text: 2対1はさすがにまずいっしょ、リーダー?
blocks.translation: Two against one is really bad, right, Leader?

blocks.text: どっちかが弱るまで待ってりゃいいんじゃないかな?
blocks.translation: Wouldn't it be better to wait until one of them weakens?

blocks.text: 見損なってもらっちゃ困るねぇ。 俺たちもそうそう捨てたもんじゃないんだよ。
blocks.translation: Don't lose faith in us. We're not something you can just throw away.

blocks.text: その間、チーム鎧武の龍玄でも襲ってみたら?
blocks.translation: In the meantime, why not try attacking Ryugen of Team Gaim?

blocks.text: 男子三日会わざれば刮目せよってなあ!
blocks.translation: They say, 'If you haven't seen a man for three days, look at him with fresh eyes!'

blocks.text: バイバイ。
blocks.translation: Bye-bye.

blocks.text: いやっ、あっ、自分で名乗るんだ･･･。
blocks.translation: No — ah, I'll introduce myself...

blocks.text: フッ、どいつもこいつもバカばっかりだ。 この勝負、俺の勝ちだな。
blocks.translation: Heh — they're all idiots. This victory is mine.

blocks.text:
え、えっ、えー!?おい! なんで俺グリドンなんだよ。 嫌だよもうちょっとなんかかっこいい名前･･･。
そういうこと!
blocks.translation: Wha—what!? Hey! Why am I Gridon? I don't like it — I want a cooler name... That's what's going on!

blocks.text: さてと、ロックシードは、と。 おっ、はっはーん。
blocks.translation: Now then, the Lockseed is... Oh, aha—

blocks.text: まだまだあー!
blocks.translation: Not yet—!

blocks.text: 後々のこと考えればさ、ここで一番強くて嫌なヤツにご退場願うのがベストだよね!
blocks.translation: Thinking about later, it's best to have the strongest, most annoying guy here step out, right?

blocks.text: 無茶言わないでくれよ。 なんで俺がバロンと。 あのね初瀬ちゃん。 なんだったら俺たち
blocks.translation: Don't be ridiculous. Why should I be with Baron? Hey, Hatsuse-chan. If anything, we...

blocks.text:
3対2で手堅く勝つのもいいけどさ、4対1で圧倒的に勝つのはもっと賢いわけよ。
だろ? 鎧武のお二方。
blocks.translation: Winning safely 3-2 is fine, but winning overwhelmingly 4-1 is smarter. Right, you two from Gaim?

blocks.text: チームインヴィットがこのステージを乗っ取っちゃう手だってあったんだよ?
blocks.translation: There was even a plan for Team Invit to take over this stage, you know?

blocks.text: バロンに先こされちゃったけどね。
blocks.translation: Baron beat us to it, though.

blocks.text: おい、一緒にバロンを潰すチャンスなんだぞ! なにしやがる!
blocks.translation: Hey — this is our chance to crush Baron together! What are you doing?!

blocks.text: 戦極ドライバーが無いんじゃあ、 レイドワイルドも終わりだねえ。
blocks.translation: If there's no Sengoku Driver, then Raid Wild is finished.

blocks.text: 飛び道具なんてきったねえぞ!
blocks.translation: Projectiles are dirty!

blocks.text: ま、イチから出直すしかないんじゃないの?
blocks.translation: Well, I guess we'll just have to start over from scratch, right?

blocks.text: 今回は、たまたま調子悪かっただけだからな!
blocks.translation: This time I was just out of form!

blocks.text: さてと、こうなると、今度はまた新しい噛ませ犬を探さないとね...。
blocks.translation: Well then, we'll have to find a new punching bag...

blocks.text: さあて、どういう戦法で行こうかなあ。 え?あ、あ、あぶね!あ、あわわっべぇ・・・
blocks.translation: Now then, what tactics should I use... Eh? Ah — whoa, that was close! Ah, ah...

blocks.text: へへっ、そうこなくっちゃ。
blocks.translation: Hehe — that's how it should be.

blocks.text: いや、えおい、まままままて・・・、うわああっ! みみみ水?
blocks.translation: No, hey, w-w-w-wait... Uwaaah! W-w-water?

blocks.text: ボンジュール!
blocks.translation: Bonjour!

blocks.text: おい!?ちょっと!?
blocks.translation: Hey!? Wait!?

blocks.text: なんだよ。 アイツらだけで盛り上がっちゃってさ。 ホントだったら上手いことやってさ、
blocks.translation: What's up? They're getting all hyped on their own. If they'd done it right...

blocks.text: その名前やだなー。
blocks.translation: I don't like that name.

blocks.text: 他のチーム出し抜いて今頃俺がトップに･･･あ、そっか･･･もうランキングなくなっちゃったんだよな...。
blocks.translation: If I'd gotten the jump on the other teams, I'd be on top by now... Ah, right... the rankings are already gone...

blocks.text: 初瀬ちゃん気合入ってんねー。 そんじゃ俺も負けずに、っと。
blocks.translation: Hatsuse-chan's fired up, huh. All right, I won't be outdone.

おいしいロックシードをあっげるよー!

blocks.translation: No way, no way, no way! Whoa — this is bad! Really bad! Ow, that hurts!!

blocks.translation: Ah, wait! You bastard! Why're you laughing?! What is this? Huh? Ehh!! No way!!

blocks.text: あああー!もうやってらんねえよ! おい! いい加減にしろよこの筋肉ダルマ!
blocks.translation: Aaaaah! I can't take this anymore! Hey! Cut it out, you musclebound oaf!

blocks.text: 別に・・・お、俺は、馴れ合いたいわけじゃなくて･･･その成り行きで…。 仕方なく・・・。
blocks.translation: It's not like I want to be all buddy-buddy... it just happened that way... I had no choice...

blocks.text: もうこんな茶番ウンザリなんだよ! 本物本物うるせえしよ! ああそうだよ!
blocks.translation: I'm sick of this farce! All this 'real, real' nonsense—shut up about it! Yeah, that's right!

blocks.text: な、なんだよ。 この、黙ってる奴だけがかっこ悪いみたいな流れは。
blocks.translation: What's with this trend of people being the only ones who are uncool and keep quiet?

blocks.text: 俺はニセモンだよ! そんなこと、俺が一番よく分かってんだよ!!

blocks.translation: Don't mess with me! Don't think you can steal the spotlight while leaving me out!

blocks.text: アンタはいいよな! やりたいことハッキリしてて!だけど今の俺は、自分のやりたいことさえもハッキリしてないんだよ!!
blocks.translation: You're so lucky — you know exactly what you want to do! But right now I don't even know what I want!!

blocks.text: まあ任せとけって! この程度の修羅場! もう慣れっこさ!
blocks.translation: Leave it to me! This kind of meltdown? I'm used to it!

blocks.text: なんか、カッコつけちゃったけど、マジでヤバくないですか俺ら?

blocks.text: うるさあい!!

blocks.text: 了解!

blocks.translation: Ah. This is really boring. All things considered, maybe the time I teamed up with Hatsuse-chan was the best.

blocks.text: オッホホホホホ。 2対1だね! 悪いけど。
blocks.translation: Ohohohoho. Two against one, huh! Sorry about that.

blocks.text: 初瀬ちゃん今ごろなにやってんだろ。
blocks.translation: I wonder what Hatsuse-chan's doing right now.

blocks.text: この、なめやがって...。
blocks.translation: How dare they...

blocks.text: 他にもインベスが!? どうすんだよ・・・。
blocks.translation: There are other Inves!? What are we gonna do...

blocks.text: ザック! 今度はこっちの番だ!・・・ ザック! なにしてんのさ!?
blocks.translation: Zack! It's our turn now!... Zack! What are you doing!?

blocks.text: どうしちゃったんだよ・・・ 俺!
blocks.translation: What's wrong with me...!

blocks.text: お前、裏切んのかよ!
blocks.translation: Are you going to betray us?!

blocks.text: うわあーっ!
blocks.translation: Wahhh!

blocks.text: しっかし、味方のふりして相手の懐に潜り込むなんて、お前も相当策士だね。
blocks.translation: Still, pretending to be an ally and sneaking into the enemy's camp—you're quite the schemer.

blocks.text: おうれん··ヘへ...。
blocks.translation: Oh, Ren... heh...

blocks.text: 沢芽もまた、賑やかになってきましたね...
blocks.translation: Sawame is getting lively again...

blocks.text: 蓮さん・・・。
blocks.translation: Ren-san...

blocks.text: それでも・・・戻ってこない奴ってのは...。
blocks.translation: Even so... there are people who never come back...

blocks.text: あー! おりゃー!!
blocks.translation: Aah! Hyah!!

blocks.text: まあ、確かに、俺はまだマシですよ。 こうして、手を動かす仕事がある分だけ・・・。
blocks.translation: Well, true — I'm still better off. At least I have work that keeps my hands busy like this...

blocks.text:
パティシエ･･･なめんなよ? こんな時のために鍛え直されてきたんだよ。俺は。
お前も案外策士だなあ。
blocks.translation:
Don't underestimate me, patissier. I've been retrained for times like this.
You're surprisingly crafty yourself.

blocks.text: でも・・・呉島光実。 あいつ、どうするんですかね、これから。
blocks.translation: But... Mitsumi Kureshima. I wonder what he'll do from now on.

blocks.text: いや、おしまいってわけにはいかないでしょ。
blocks.translation: No, it can't just end like that.

blocks.text: めちゃ・・・ダメだ・・・!
blocks.translation: This is... really bad...!

blocks.text: こっちは散々迷惑かけられたんだ。 なんか、こう言う事、 あるんじゃねえの?
blocks.translation: We've been put through so much. Don't things like this happen sometimes?

blocks.translation: Lines

blocks.text: お店来るなんて久し振りじゃないですか。 あ、心配なんて無用ですよ。
blocks.translation: It's been a while since you came to the shop. Ah, there's no need to worry.

blocks.text: これは・・・ありがとう、 初瀬ちゃん・・・。
blocks.translation: This is... thank you, Hatsuse-chan...

blocks.text:
俺は、スイーツ界のスターですから。 いつか、弟子は師匠を超えちゃうもんなんですね。
ちょっと早すぎたかー?ははは。
blocks.translation:
I'm a star in the sweets world. Someday a disciple will surpass the master.
Maybe it's a little too early—hahaha.

blocks.text: 初めてグリドンがパワーアップした･･･。 こいつなら･･･いける!
blocks.translation: Gridon has powered up for the first time... With this, he can do it!

blocks.text: なんかキメ台詞言わないとな･･･最高のスイーツに、酔わせてやるぜ。
blocks.translation: I should say a catchphrase or something... I'll make you swoon with the best sweets.

blocks.text: 師匠!? ななな何するんですか!?
blocks.translation: Master!? W-what are you doing!?

blocks.text: 目を醒ましてください! 師匠!
blocks.translation: Please wake up, Master!

blocks.text: カッコ悪すぎですよ! 俺の人気を妬んで、 こんなことするなんて!
blocks.translation: That's so uncool! To do something like this because you're jealous of my popularity!

blocks.text: うわあああああああ!
blocks.translation: Waaaah!

blocks.text: 俺はもう戦いなんて･･･ あんなヘナチョコだったあの頃から・・・ 俺は俺で頑張ってきたんだ･･･。
blocks.translation: I don't want to fight anymore... Ever since I was such a weakling back then... I've been doing my best on my own...

blocks.text: 師匠! 大丈夫ですか!
blocks.translation: Master! Are you okay!?

blocks.text: 師匠! あんたは俺が救ってみせる! 変身!
blocks.translation: Master! I'll save you! Transform!

blocks.text: 無茶しないでくださいよ。
blocks.translation: Don't do anything reckless.

blocks.text: くっそー、俺は昔のままの俺じゃない!
blocks.translation: Damn it—I'm not the same guy I used to be!

blocks.text: 師匠。
blocks.translation: Master.

blocks.text: 師匠! あんたは俺が知ってる中で一番強い男だ! なんだかわかんないような奴に
blocks.translation: Master! You're the strongest man I know!

blocks.text: 18 店に戻ってきてください。
blocks.translation: 18 Please come back to the store.

blocks.text: 操られるような男じゃない。 アンタは、 男の中の漢なんだー!
blocks.translation: You're not the sort of man who can be controlled. You're a real man among men!

blocks.text: また一から、もう一度修行したいんです!
blocks.translation: I want to start training again from scratch!

blocks.text:
ヘルヘイムの実･･･ もしかして!・・・変わらない・・・だめか･･･ くっそ･･･ こうなったら...。
初瀬ちゃん…なんで?
blocks.translation:
A Helheim fruit... maybe!... It won't change... it's no good... damn... If it's come to this...
Hatsuse-chan... why?

blocks.text: ありがとうございます!
blocks.translation: Thank you!

blocks.text: えええ・・・えー••• うおおおおお!
blocks.translation: Ehh... Whoaa!
