blocks.text: 台詞
blocks.translation: Lines

blocks.text: 甘ったれんじゃないわよ! そうやって気安く人前に立つなって言ってんの!
blocks.translation: Don't be so spoiled! Don't go standing in front of people so casually!

blocks.text: そうよ。 私こそが本物のプロフェッショナルよ。
blocks.translation: That's right. I am the true professional.

blocks.text: パティシエとお呼びなさい!
blocks.translation: Call me Patissier!

blocks.text: だまらっしゃい!
blocks.translation: Be quiet!

blocks.text: アナタ誕生日は? フッ、水瓶座ね。 ワテクシとは相性最悪一。 おまけにエスプリに乏しい受け答え、
blocks.translation: What's your birthday? Hah — Aquarius. We're the worst match. And your replies lack any esprit,

blocks.text: あー! アマチュア風情がよくも・・・。
blocks.translation: Ah! The nerve of an amateur...

blocks.text: エレガンスのカケラもないファッションセンス。ノンノンノン。 アナタ不採用。
blocks.translation: Your fashion sense has not a shred of elegance. No, no, no. You're not hired.

blocks.text: あらいけない! パイ生地が焼き上がる時間だわ! 覚えておきなさい!
blocks.translation: Oh dear! It's time for the pie crust to finish baking! Remember that!

blocks.text: その短絡的な発想が! すでにアナタの貧困な感性を物語っているの!
blocks.translation: That short-sighted idea already reveals how impoverished your sensibility is!

blocks.text: あー痛い、痛い痛い・・・これで勝ったと、思わないことねー!
blocks.translation: Ow, ow, ow... Don't go thinking you've won with this!

blocks.text: 素材人材すべてにおいて本物の一品を揃えること。 それが当店の揺るがぬポリスィー。
blocks.translation: To stock only genuine, top-quality items in every ingredient and staff selection. That is our shop's unshakable policy.

blocks.text: ちょっとお待ちなさい! さいさい…。 こんな楽しそうなイベントにワテクシを呼ばないとは、一体どういうことかしら?
blocks.translation: Wait a moment! Wait, wait... How could you not invite me to such a delightful event?

blocks.text: 本物を知りたいのなら、もっと男を磨いてから出直していらっしゃい。 アデュー!
blocks.translation: If you want to know the real thing, come back after you've polished yourself as a man. Adieu!

blocks.text: 22 ホッホッホッホッホッホッ、オッホッホッホッホッホッ、 お先にー。スパード坊や。
blocks.translation: 22 Ho ho ho ho ho ho, oh ho ho ho ho ho — I'll go ahead, little Spard.

blocks.text: 呆れたわねー。 本当に素人のケンカじゃない。 近頃の子どもたちはこんな茶番を見て
blocks.translation: I'm shocked. This is truly an amateurish fight. Kids these days watch this farce and...

blocks.text: こんな面白くもないルールよりも、二人で楽しみましょう。 ムッシュ、バナーヌ?
blocks.translation: Rather than these boring rules, let's enjoy ourselves together — Monsieur Banane?

blocks.text: 喜んでるの? なにもかもニセモノ。 アマチュアのごっこ遊び。 まがい物は本物の輝きを曇らせる。
blocks.translation: Are you pleased? Everything's fake. Amateur play-acting. Imitations dull the shine of the real thing.

blocks.text: いいこと?クリスマスってのはね、パティシエにとって一年で一番忙しい時なの。
blocks.translation: Listen: Christmas is the busiest time of the year for pastry chefs.

blocks.text: このままでは世間が本物のパッションを忘れてしまうわ! 放っておけないわね。
blocks.translation: If things continue like this, the world will forget real passion! We can't just leave it be.

blocks.text: あら、してるわよ! まずはバナーナの下ごしらえ。 全部むいて、 丸裸にしてあげるわー!
blocks.translation: Oh, I am! First, prepare the bananas. I'll peel them all — strip them bare!

blocks.text: 誰かが本物の戦場、本物のバトルというものを見せつけてあげないと。
blocks.translation: Someone has to show them a real battlefield — a real battle.

blocks.text: 26 あらスペール。 ずいぶんと鍛え直してきたわね。 ご褒美にマンゴープリンにしてあげるわ!
blocks.translation: 26 Oh, Sperl. You've really retrained yourself. As a reward I'll make you mango pudding!

blocks.text: ワテクシがギャラリーの皆様をお招きしましたの。 記念すべき初舞台ですものね。
blocks.translation: I invited everyone in the gallery. It's a memorable debut performance, after all.

blocks.text: トレビアーン! なんて美しい。 戦場に咲く白い花、あるいは泉に舞い降りた白鳥。 ああ、 あなたは一体・・・?
blocks.translation: Très bien! How beautiful. Like a white flower blooming on the battlefield, or a swan descending into a fountain. Ah — who are you?

blocks.text:
ワテクシはアナタたちのくだらないお遊戯に新たなる風雲を呼び起こす者。 凰蓮・ピエール・アルフォンソ。
さあ始めますわよ。 破壊と暴力のパジェントを!
blocks.translation:
I am the one who will stir new storms into your silly little play. Oren Pierre Alfonso.
Now then — the pageant of destruction and violence begins!

blocks.text: ああ、いい一･･･。 せめてお名前を･･･。
blocks.translation: Ah, that's nice... At least tell me your name...

blocks.text: で?アタ誕生日は? 乙女座一! あらそう! ちょっと頼りない気もするけれど、
blocks.translation: So? What's your birthday? Virgo! Oh really! You seem a bit unreliable, though...

blocks.text:
古来より戦いとは、エンターテイメント! 時のローマ皇帝はコロシアムで剣闘士を戦わせ、
市民に娯楽の興奮を提供したものよ! 今からここで、 最高のショーを披露してあげるわ!
blocks.translation:
Since ancient times, battle has been entertainment! The Roman emperors had gladiators fight in the Colosseum to give citizens thrilling amusement!
From now on, right here, I'll put on the greatest show!

blocks.text: 鍛え方次第によっては、 んーどうにかなるかもね!
blocks.translation: Depending on how you train, hmm — it might work out!

blocks.text: セボン! ハイ! ハイ! ハイ!
blocks.translation: C'est bon! Yes! Yes! Yes!

blocks.text: なんて貧弱。 これが本当の戦場なら、5秒で袋詰めよ? アナタ?
blocks.translation: How pathetic. If this were a real battlefield, you'd be bagged in five seconds, you know?

blocks.text:
プロの世界のエンターテイメントは残酷なの。プレイヤーはすべて血に飢えた観客たちへの
供物! そこがアマチュアのお遊びとのちがい!
blocks.translation: Professional entertainment is brutal. Players are offerings to bloodthirsty spectators! That's what makes it different from amateur play!

blocks.text:
すっとぼけてるんじゃないわよ! 気合を入れて混ぜなさい! モタモタしてると固まるだろうが!ほら急げ!
もうまるっきり悪役のセリフね。 ムッシュバナーヌ。
blocks.translation:
Don't play dumb! Put some spirit into your mixing! If you lollygag it'll set — hurry up!
That's totally a villain's line, Monsieur Banane.

blocks.text: アナタたちとは、鍛え方が違いましてよ?
blocks.translation: Our training methods are different from yours, you know?

blocks.text: なかなか美しいじゃない。 アマチュアにしては、上出来よ。 でも気をつけなさい。 美しさと脆さは紙一重!
blocks.translation: Not bad at all — it's quite beautiful. For an amateur, it's excellent. But be careful: there's only a hair's breadth between beauty and fragility!

blocks.text: あなた見どころありそうね。鍛え直してまた出直していらっしゃい。 サリュー!
blocks.translation: You show promise. Go train again and come back when you're ready. Salut!

blocks.text: 芸術は、選りすぐりの本物だけを残していかなきゃ。
blocks.translation: Art must preserve only the carefully selected, genuine works.

blocks.text: アータたちのようなニセモノを誰もが放っておくから、文化が廃れてしまうのよ!
blocks.translation: If everyone leaves fakes like you alone, culture will wither away!

blocks.text:
ワテクシは凰蓮・ピエール・アルフォンゾ。 またの名を、正義の味方、 アーマードライダー、ブラーボ!
ボンソワール! 沢芽市の皆様、 危険な怪物の跳梁跋扈に、不安な夜をお過ごしかと存じます。
全ては嘆かわしく愚かな子供たち、ビートライダーズの仕業なのです。 ですが、ご安心を。
これからはワテクシ、ブラーボが街の平和を守って差し上げますわ。 もちろん、子供たちは
ワテクシが厳しい指導によってキッチリと躾け直します。 既にビートライダーズのリーダーが
一人、ワテクシの元で立派に更生しつつありますの。 オルポワール。
blocks.translation:
I am 鳳蓮・ピエール・アルフォンゾ. Also known as the ally of justice, Armored Rider Bravo!
Bonsoir! Citizens of Zawame City — I imagine you have been spending anxious nights as dangerous monsters run rampant.
It is all the lamentable, foolish children known as the Beat Riders who are responsible. But rest assured.
From now on, I, Bravo, will protect the peace of the city. Of course, I will sternly retrain and properly discipline those children. Already, one of the Beat Riders' leaders is being splendidly reformed under my tutelage. Au revoir.

blocks.text: 台同
blocks.translation: Taitong

blocks.text: 台同
blocks.translation: Taitong

blocks.text: ボンジュール、モンダリン、いつぞやの借りを返しに、来たわよ!
blocks.translation: Bonjour, Mondarin — I'm here to repay a favor from some time ago!

blocks.text: もう、困った子ね。 えっ? ボウヤ・・・ ボウヤー!?
blocks.translation: Oh, you naughty child. Huh? Boy... Boy!?

blocks.text: あのね、 怪物退治なんて契約には含まれてないの。 余計なことに手を出して本来の依頼を
blocks.translation: Listen, monster-hunting isn't part of the contract. Getting involved in extra things and neglecting the original request...

blocks.text: まったく、アータってホントのホントにバカね。 あんな無茶するなんて。 ... でも、なかなか素敵だったわ。
blocks.translation: Good grief, Arta, you're really, really stupid. Doing something so reckless... but it was rather wonderful.

blocks.text: おろそかにするなんて、プロにあるまじき失態だわっ!
blocks.translation: Neglecting your duties like that is an unforgivable lapse for a professional!

blocks.text: アータもどうやら一皮むけたようね。 ちょっとだけ認めてあげてもよろしくてよ。 ボウヤ。
blocks.translation: It seems you've shed a layer, too. I suppose I can give you a little credit, boy.

blocks.text: 行くわよー!
blocks.translation: Here I go!

blocks.text: あーーー! 麗しの白いお方! なんか以前よりも逞しくなってて、ス・テ・キ!
blocks.translation: Ahhh! What a beautiful white lady! She looks even stronger than before, it's amazing!

blocks.text: ちょ・・・ 調子に乗ってんじゃ、ないわよ!
blocks.translation: Hey... don't get cocky!

blocks.text: あ・・・･ウィームッシュ!
blocks.translation: Ah... Weemush!

blocks.text: ここは一時撤退よ! ムースの仕込みもしなくっちゃ!
blocks.translation: This is a temporary retreat! We still have to get the mousse ready!

blocks.text: ジュテー
blocks.translation: Jutée

blocks.text: ・ム!よかった...。
blocks.translation: Phew! That's good...

blocks.text: まったく、あの子もまだまだ教育が足りないわね。 ロックシードをすり替えておいて正解だったわ。
blocks.translation: Honestly, that kid still needs more training. Swapping the Lockseed was the right move.

blocks.text: いいえ、ワテクシ本望ですわ。 これでようやくアナタの腕の中に…。
blocks.translation: No, I'm perfectly content. Now I can finally be in your arms...

blocks.text:
当店のスイーツを堪能して下さっているお客様には、万が一にも失礼があってはならないわ。
ワテクシのミッションは戦極ドライバーの回収! ボウヤがきちんとこの場に持ってきた時点で、
blocks.translation: We must never be rude to customers who are enjoying our sweets. My mission is to recover the Sengoku Driver! The moment the boy properly brought it here,

blocks.text: ぼーっとしてんじゃないわよ。 いい大人のくせに、こんな子供たちだけに戦わせておくつもり?
blocks.translation: Don't just sit there spacing out. You're an adult — are you really going to leave these kids to fight on their own?

blocks.text: そうよねえ。ノンギャラで戦うなんてアマチュアの極み。 ただ負けたくないってだけの幼稚な
blocks.translation: That's right. Fighting for free is the height of amateurism. It's just childish — simply not wanting to lose.

blocks.text: 後は力ずくで奪い取れば済む話でしょ。
blocks.translation: After that, we can just take it by force.

blocks.text: ポリシー。 でもそれはそれで、見守ってあげたくなっちゃうのよねえ。
blocks.translation: A policy. But even so, it makes me want to look after them a little.

blocks.text: ホッホッホッホッホ これがワテクシの仕事の流儀。
blocks.translation: Ho ho ho ho ho — this is my way of doing business.

blocks.text: 理にかなった作戦ね。 よろしくてよ。
blocks.translation: A sensible plan. I'm fine with it.

blocks.text: あとはアータ次第よ? 水瓶座のボウヤ。 大人しくベルトを差し出すか、
blocks.translation: Now it's up to you, Aquarius boy. Either hand the belt over quietly,

blocks.text: 粘りに粘って・・・チャンスを待つの!
blocks.translation: or hang on and wait for your chance!

blocks.text: ケガをしてから差し出すか、好きな方を選びなさい。
blocks.translation: Either present it after you get hurt, or choose whichever you prefer.

blocks.text: コイツはニセモノよ! コイツにはエレガンスが欠けてる!ワテクシの目は誤魔化せないわ!
blocks.translation: This one's a fake! It lacks elegance! You can't fool my eyes!

blocks.text: これまではいつも二人がかりでワテクシと張り合ってきたくせに、
blocks.translation: Up until now, they've always been competing with me together,

blocks.text: メロンの君を騙るなんて不届き者!許せないわー。
blocks.translation: How dare you impersonate Melon-kun! Unforgivable!

blocks.text: たった一人で勝ち目があるとでも!?
blocks.translation: Do you really think you have a chance of winning all on your own!?

blocks.text: まったく、とことん面倒な子たちね。
blocks.translation: Honestly, what utterly troublesome kids.

blocks.text: バカモーーーン! さぼってんじゃないわよ!
blocks.translation: You idiooooot! Don't you dare slack off!

blocks.text: ここはワテクシたちが足止めするわ! さ! 早くお行きなさい!アータたちがさっさといなくなれば、
blocks.translation: We'll hold them off here! Now go! Hurry up and get out of here! If Arta and the others are gone quickly,

blocks.text: ここはワテクシのステージよ。
blocks.translation: this is my stage.

blocks.text: それだけ早くワテクシたちも逃げられるの! 早く行きなさい!
blocks.translation: That way we can escape even sooner! Hurry and go!

blocks.text: オッホッホッホッホッホ! たーんとしぼって、あ・げ・る。
blocks.translation: Ohohohohoho! I'll squeeze it out for you — plenty, and give it to you.

blocks.text: ここが根性の見せ所よボウヤ。 気合いれて行くわよ!!
blocks.translation: This is where you show your guts, boy. Put some spirit into it!

blocks.text: パーティシーエたーいりょーくきーほんだよー
blocks.translation: Party C—stamina basics, you know~

blocks.text: ワテクシもいるわよ、ニセモノボウヤ。
blocks.translation: I'm here too, fake boy.

blocks.text: ハイハイハイハイハイ! 登れー! 登れオラー! ハイおいで! おいで! さあ! さあ!
blocks.translation: Alright, alright, climb up! Climb, come on! Come here! Come on! Come on!

blocks.text: フフフフフ。 さあ、 メロンの君の仇討ちよ!
blocks.translation: Heh heh heh heh. Now — avenge Melon-kun!

blocks.text:
アーアアー!ハイ! ハイ! ハイ! ホレホレ! ハッ! さー、ぼうや! ワテクシをつかまえてごらーん!
ハハー! アハハハー! アハハハー! オッケー! アハッ!
blocks.translation:
Aaaah! Yes! Yes! Yes! Come on! Ha! Now, boy! Try and catch me!
Haha! Ahahaha! Ahahaha! Okay! Aha!

blocks.text: キツいお仕置きが必要みたいね。
blocks.translation: Looks like a stern punishment is in order.

blocks.text: 戦場ではアンタのような人間をたくさん見てきたわ。 力に溺れたわね。
blocks.translation: On the battlefield I've seen many people like you. You've been intoxicated by power.

blocks.text: いい? 本物になりたければ強いだけじゃダメ! なによりもそう、 美しくないと。
blocks.translation: Listen: if you want to be the genuine article, being strong isn't enough — above all, you must be beautiful.

blocks.text: おどき! 自分たちが何をしてるか、分かってんの!?
blocks.translation: Get out of the way! Do you even know what you're doing!?

blocks.text: 違う! もっとこう、エレガントに、うっふーん。 ハイ!
blocks.translation: No! More like make it elegant — ooh la la. Yes!

blocks.text: ザック! どういうつもり!?
blocks.translation: Zack! What are you thinking!?

blocks.text: 違う! もっとこう、ビューティフルに、あはーん。 違う!違う!!
blocks.translation: No! More like—be beautiful, ahh. No! No!!

blocks.text: アイツは最初に人類を裏切ったの。 今のアナタは正義の味方よ。
blocks.translation: He was the first to betray humanity. Now you are a champion of justice.

blocks.text: 53 泣いてる場合じゃないわ。 もう一度最初からいくわよ。
blocks.translation: 53 This is no time for tears. We'll go back to the start once more.

blocks.text: この街を故郷だと思ってる人たちが、これだけ大勢いたってことよね。
blocks.translation: It just means there are this many people who think of this town as their home.

blocks.text: どうしたの? この程度でネを上げてちゃ、 本物にはなれないわよ。
blocks.translation: What's the matter? If you give up at this level, you'll never become the real thing.

blocks.text: ユグドラシルが無くなっても、ちゃんと帰ってきてくれる
blocks.translation: Even if Yggdrasil disappears, they'll return properly.

blocks.text:
アータって、ホンットにバカね・・・。 やりたいことがハッキリしてないなんて、 当たり前じゃない。
それはそうと水瓶座のボウヤ。 ウチの子をまた不良の道に引きずり込む気ね。 いいこと。
blocks.translation: Arta, you really are such an idiot... Not having a clear idea of what you want to do — it's obvious. By the way, Aquarius boy, you're planning to drag my kid back into delinquency again, aren't you? Good.

blocks.text: 考えたって仕方ないことよりも、今やらなきゃいけないことにちゃんと目を向けなさい。
blocks.translation: Rather than dwelling on things you can't change, focus on what you must do now.

blocks.text: まだまだ世の中大変なんだから。
blocks.translation: The world is still a hard place.

blocks.text: その子はね、今が一番大切な時。 本物になろうと必死に足掻いてるのよ。
blocks.translation: For that child, now is the most important time. He's scrabbling desperately to become the real thing.

blocks.text: どうもこうもないわ。 何をやったにせよ子供だもの。 オーバーロードに騙されて利用されてた。
blocks.translation: There's nothing to be done — whatever he did, he was a child. He was deceived and used by the Overlord.

blocks.text: それをアータみたいな不良に邪魔させないわ!
blocks.translation: I won't let a delinquent like Arta get in the way of that!

blocks.text: みんなと同じ被害者。 そういう扱いでおしまいよ。
blocks.translation: A victim like everyone else. Treat him as such and let it end there.

blocks.text: 問答無用、 変身!
blocks.translation: No questions asked — transform!

blocks.text: そう、だからって、犯した過ちを忘れられることはできない。
blocks.translation: That said, the mistakes you've committed can't simply be forgotten.

blocks.text: 素人の目は誤魔化せても、プロフェッショナルなワテクシの目は・・・あー痛い痛い痛い・・・
blocks.translation: You might fool an amateur's eye, but you can't fool a professional like me... ah—ouch, ouch, ouch...

blocks.text:
58 誤魔化せないわ! インベスと戦ってるのはアータたちの自作自演! 図星でしょ!
ほらごらんなさい! これが動かぬ証拠よ!
blocks.translation:
58 You can't fool me! The battles against the Inves were staged by Arta and the others! Nailed it, right?
Look! This is irrefutable proof!

blocks.text:
ある意味で、一番かわいそうなのはあの子自身よ。 あの子の罪を理解して、どう償えばいいか
教えてあげられる人間が、 誰もいないっていうのはね...。
ほんとにみずくさい子ね。
blocks.translation: In a way, the one who is most pitiable is the child himself. That there isn't anyone who understands his sin and can teach him how to atone... It's really cold-hearted, isn't it.

blocks.text: 台詞
blocks.translation: Lines

blocks.text: まさかと思って探りに来てみればこのバカ面。 もしかしてフェイク?
blocks.translation: I couldn't believe it, so I came snooping — and it's this stupid face. Could it be a fake?

blocks.text: アータ、ワタシに何か隠していない? 新しいフルーツ、とか...。
blocks.translation: Arta, are you hiding something from me? A new fruit, or something...?

blocks.text: 新しく手に入れたフルーツってまさか!
blocks.translation: The new fruit you just got — could it be that?!

blocks.text: 台詞
blocks.translation: Lines

blocks.text: ウウッ･･･ウウッ･･･ ウウウウウッ・・・。
blocks.translation: Ugh... ugh... uuuuu...

blocks.text: 触らないでー!･･･このぐらい･･･全然、平気なのー!
blocks.translation: Don't touch me! ...This much... I'm totally fine!

blocks.text: はっ…少しは元のアータに、戻ったみたいね!
blocks.translation: Ha... looks like a bit of the old Arta has come back!

blocks.text: ちょっとワタシにこんなもんを食べさせようっていうの!? パティシエ失格よ!
blocks.translation: You're trying to feed me something like that?! You're unfit to be a patissier!

blocks.text: 12 お運びなさい! メルシーね。 メルシーね。
blocks.translation: 12 Carry it! Merci. Merci.

blocks.text: アーマードライダー、グリドン!?･･･アータ・・・なの?
blocks.translation: Armored Rider, Gridon!? ...Is that Arta...?

blocks.text: 何かしら。
blocks.translation: Who can tell?

blocks.text: ってなんで逃げるのよ!・・・やっぱりあの子・・・ 覚悟を･･･決めなきゃいけないのかしら。
blocks.translation: Then why are you running away!? ...After all, that kid... maybe I have to make up my mind.

blocks.text: もうアータのお店じゃない。
blocks.translation: It's not Arta's shop anymore.

blocks.text: あら?わからない? こういうことよ。
blocks.translation: Huh? You don't understand? This is what I mean.

blocks.text: 言ったわね〜。 それじゃあ、アテクシが、本気で一から叩き直してあげるわ。
blocks.translation: You said it—then I'll really set you straight from the beginning.

blocks.text: ふっ、この期に及んで言い訳しても無駄よ! 道を誤った弟子を正すのも師匠の務め。
blocks.translation: Ha, it's useless to make excuses at this point! It's a master's duty to correct a student who has strayed.

blocks.text: せめて楽に送ってあげる。
blocks.translation: At least I'll make your passing easy.

blocks.text:
ふれっ!ははは。 ちょっと、しっかりなさい! じゃあまずは筋トレよ。
アテクシをおぶったまま、 お店まで、ダッシュー!
blocks.translation: Hah! Hahaha. Now, get a grip! First — muscle training. With me piggybacked on you, dash to the shop!

blocks.text: え? ええ? ちょちょちょちょっと何よこれ!? アータ、一体何するつもり!? ああ一つ、・・・うぉおおおおおおああああああっ!
blocks.translation: Eh? Wha—? W-w-w-what is this!? Arta, what on earth are you planning to do!? Ah — one thing... Wooooaaaahhh!

blocks.text: 台詞
blocks.translation: Lines

blocks.text: 1 俺は、アーマードライダー、黒影。 そしてコイツは、グリドン。
blocks.translation: 1 I am the Armored Rider, Kurokage. And this guy is Gridon.

blocks.text: 台詞
blocks.translation: Lines

blocks.text: なんだお前ら! 見せもんじゃねえぞ!
blocks.translation: What are you lot doing!? This isn't a show!

blocks.text: ようはケンカ売られてるってことだよな? だったら買うぜ!行けー! グリドン!
blocks.translation: So basically you're picking a fight, right? Then I'll accept it! Go—Gridon!

blocks.text: いいだろグリドンで・・・。
blocks.translation: Alright then, with Gridon...

blocks.text: テメエの言う通り、こっから先は仕切り直しだ!
blocks.translation: Like you said, from here on out it's a reset!

blocks.text: 10 おいグリドーン! おいグリドンチームワークだ! 痛って・・・おいグリドーン!
blocks.translation: 10 Hey, Gridon! Hey Gridon — teamwork! Ouch... hey Gridon!

blocks.text: そのベルトをぶち砕いて、二度と変身できなくしてやるぜ。
blocks.translation: I'll smash that belt to pieces and make sure you can never transform again.

blocks.text: 痛い! このやろー … うわっ、なにしやがる!?
blocks.translation: Ouch! You bastard... Whoa, what are you doing!?

blocks.text: 覚えてやがれ!
blocks.translation: I'll remember this!

blocks.text: 12 城之内! 行くぞ!
blocks.translation: 12 Jonouchi! Let's go!

blocks.text: ここなら誰の邪魔も入らねえだろう。
blocks.translation: No one's going to interfere here.

blocks.text: アーマードライダー黒影! この勝負に勝って必ずランキングトップになってやるぜ!
blocks.translation: Armored Rider Kurokage! I'll win this match and make sure I become the top of the rankings!

blocks.text: 俺の立てた作戦はこうだ。 まずはお前が先に立って敵を威嚇する。 そして、敵に十分
blocks.translation: This is the plan I came up with. First, you step forward and intimidate the enemy. Then,

blocks.text: おいグリドン、なにをモタモタやってやがる!
blocks.translation: Hey Gridon, what are you dawdling for!?

blocks.text: 近づいたところで、 お前が仕掛けると見せかけて･･･。 俺が槍で一撃! とあ! どうだ。
blocks.translation: When they get close, you fake an attack... then I'll strike once with my spear! Take that! How's that?

blocks.text: はー、やっぱグリドン頭いいなー。
blocks.translation: Ha— as I thought, Gridon really is clever.

blocks.text: 台詞
blocks.translation: lines

blocks.text: 台詞
blocks.translation: lines

blocks.text: そういうこと。
blocks.translation: That's it.

blocks.text: なんで今になって俺たちに挑戦を? バロンの標的は鎧武じゃなかったのか?
blocks.translation: Why are you challenging us now? Wasn't Baron's target Gaim?

blocks.text: 抜き足差し足、忍び足・・・うらぁ!
blocks.translation: Tiptoe, sliding steps, creeping steps... Uraa!
...! ...If that's the case...!

blocks.text: そんなの関係ねえ。 今度こそ引導を渡してやるぜ! うらぁ!
blocks.translation: That doesn't matter. This time I'll deliver the final blow! Uraa!

blocks.text: オイ、グリドンはどうした。 黙って見てるだけか!?チームワークはどうなったんだよ!
blocks.translation: Hey, what happened to Gridon? Are you just watching silently? What happened to your teamwork?

blocks.text: おい! 俺は、どうすればいい?
blocks.translation: Hey! What should I do?

blocks.text: は…? 城之内･･･お前･･･。
blocks.translation: Huh...? Jonouchi... you...

blocks.text: 許せねえ! 俺はこのままじゃただの雑魚だ!
blocks.translation: I won't forgive this! If I stay like this I'll just be a weakling!

blocks.text: オイ、 お前らどこ行くんだ!? おい!!
blocks.translation: Hey, where are you guys going!? Hey!

blocks.text: おお、グッドアイデア! 行ってくるぜ!
blocks.translation: Oh, great idea! I'm off!

blocks.text: なんで、俺が怯えなきゃならねえんだよあんなヤツクソクソクソお・・・。
blocks.translation: Why do I have to be scared of that guy, damn damn damn...

blocks.text: ・・・なんだ? 初めて見るアーマードライダーだな。 俺が戦いってもんを教えてやるよ!
blocks.translation: ...What? This is the first time I've seen an Armored Rider. I'll teach you all about fighting!

blocks.text: 力さえあれば･･･もう一度あの力さえあれば!
blocks.translation: If only I had the power... If only I had that power once more!

blocks.text: 随分と逃げ腰じゃねぇか。 ええ!? これで終わりだ! ウラァー!
blocks.translation: You're being pretty cowardly. Huh!? This is the end! Uraaa!

blocks.text: アイツのせいで···俺は...。
blocks.translation: Because of him...I...

blocks.text: 残念だが、俺にはある!
blocks.translation: Too bad for you — I have it!

blocks.text: 力･･･アイツらの力が･･･なんで俺には無いんだ…。 コイツを･･･もう一度俺に力を!
blocks.translation: Power... their power... why don't I have it...? This thing... give me power once more!

blocks.text: この野郎!
blocks.translation: You bastard!

1 Wait! This isn't just Gaim's stage right now. I won't let you fight alone!

blocks.text: 台詞
blocks.translation: lines

blocks.text: 俺のこと、味方だと思ってるヤツを、 これから裏切って罠にはめるんだぜ?
blocks.translation: I'm going to betray and trap those who think I'm on their side, you know?

blocks.text: 俺はチームバロンのリーダー、ザック! アーマードライダーナックルだ!
blocks.translation: I'm Zack, the leader of Team Baron! Armored Rider Knuckle!

blocks.text: 戒斗は、いつだってなにかと戦ってきた。 あんな力を手に入れて、 ユグドラシルも
blocks.translation: Kaito has always been fighting something. He gained that kind of power, and Yggdrasil...

blocks.text: 一緒に戦うぞ! インベスは任せてくれ!
blocks.translation: Let's fight together! Leave the Inves to me!

blocks.text: オーバーロードも倒した後で、 アイツが次に牙をむく相手が誰なのか、ずっとそれが心配だった
blocks.translation: After defeating Overlord, I was always worried about who he would turn his fangs on next.
Kaito...!

blocks.text: 戒斗は俺が止める。
blocks.translation: I'll stop Kaito.

blocks.text: 戒斗! 見ててくれー!
blocks.translation: Kaito! Watch me!

blocks.text: そうまでして世界を滅ぼすことに、何の価値がある?
blocks.translation: What's the point in destroying the world like that?

blocks.text: 一緒に行くぞ! これで最後だー!
blocks.translation: Let's go together! This is the last time!

blocks.text: アンタからリーダーを引き継いで、俺は変わった。 戦う意味を、 誰かを守る誇らしさを知った。
blocks.translation: Taking over as leader from you has changed me. I've learned the meaning of fighting, and the pride of protecting someone.
Kaito...

blocks.text: だが戒斗、アンタはどうしてそうなった。 それがアンタの求めてた、強さか?
blocks.translation: But Kaito, how did you end up like this? Is that the strength you were looking for?

blocks.text: 俺達がどうにかするしかない! か･･･。 アーマードライダーは俺だけじゃない。
blocks.translation: We have no choice but to do something about this! I'm not the only Armored Rider.

blocks.text: そうか...。 結局アンタは、なにひとつ変わってないんだな。
blocks.translation: I see... So you haven't changed at all after all.

blocks.text: ミッチもいるし、紘汰だって頼めば手伝ってくれるだろ。
blocks.translation: There's Mitch, and even Kouta would help if you asked him.

blocks.text: しまった・・・。
blocks.translation: Oh no...

blocks.text: 紘汰、大変だ。 またインベスだ! 今度はただ暴れるんじゃなくて金を奪おうとしている!
blocks.translation: Kouta, this is bad. It's the Inves again! This time they're not just causing trouble, they're trying to steal money!

blocks.text: 43 オレのつとめだ!
blocks.translation: 43 It's my job!

blocks.text: こいつは誰かが錠前でコントロールしているぞ。
blocks.translation: Someone is controlling this with a lock.

blocks.text: 俺には守るものが、 ある! 犠牲を越えて、戦う価値がある!
blocks.translation: I have something to protect! It's worth fighting for, even at the cost of everything!

blocks.text: 紘汰! アイツらを追え!
blocks.translation: Kouta! Go after them!

blocks.text: うおおおおおおッ! 戒斗ォー!
blocks.translation: Uooooooo! Kaito!

blocks.text: おう。任せてくれ。
blocks.translation: Okay. Leave it to me.

blocks.text: ･･･俺が･･･最後じゃない･･･誰かが･･･また...。
blocks.translation: ...I won't be the last... Someone else will be there...

blocks.text: まあまあ落ち着こうぜ。 そう心配するなって紘汰。 この程度じゃまだまだ余裕だぜ。
blocks.translation: Now, calm down. Don't worry so much, Kouta. This is nothing to worry about yet.

blocks.text: ミッチ! みんな逃げろ! 数が多すぎる!
blocks.translation: Mitch! Everyone run! There are too many of them!

blocks.text: それが分かっててどうしてアイツらなんかと!
blocks.translation: Knowing that, why would you be with those guys?

blocks.text: よう! ･･･なんか、不思議なもんだな。 こうして、みんなが笑ってると、 世界のピンチなんて、
blocks.translation: Hey! It's strange. With everyone laughing like this, it doesn't seem like the world is in trouble.

blocks.text: 嘘だったみたいに思えてくる。 誰が戦って、誰が世界を救ったのか、
blocks.translation: It seems like a lie. Who fought, who saved the world?

blocks.text: ホントのところを知ってるヤツらともなれば、 それこそ･･･ 俺たちぐらいなもんだ。
blocks.translation: When it comes to people who know the truth, it's really just us.

blocks.text: お前だって、いいように利用されてるだけじゃないのか?
blocks.translation: Aren't you just being used?

blocks.text: なあ、ミッチ! だからさ! 紘汰や舞や戒斗の事、思い出して話が出来る相手ってそれだけで貴重
blocks.translation: Hey, Mitch! That's why — just having someone you can remember and talk with about Kouta, Mai, and Kaito is precious.

blocks.text: 俺も行くぜ。 戒斗。
blocks.translation: I'll go too, Kaito.

blocks.text: なんだよ! 他にはいない仲間っつーかさ だからさ! もう一度一緒に踊らないか? 俺たちと!
blocks.translation: What's that?! We're like friends like no other, so why don't you dance with us again? With us!

blocks.text: おい! また黙って消える気かよ。
blocks.translation: Hey! Are you just going to quietly disappear again?

blocks.text: おう……。
blocks.translation: Ou…….

blocks.text: アンタたちには任せておけねぇな!
blocks.translation: I can't leave it to you guys!

blocks.text: 俺たちは弱い。 だが、弱いからこそ強くなれる。 これまでも、これからも。
blocks.translation: We are weak. But it is because we are weak that we can become strong. That has always been the case, and will continue to be the case.

blocks.text: 俺はバロンの名前を汚すヤツを許すつもりはない。 ネオバロンは、俺が潰す。
blocks.translation: I have no intention of forgiving anyone who tarnishes the name of Baron. I will destroy Neo Baron.

blocks.text: 行くぜ!
blocks.translation: Let's go!

blocks.text: 今なら押し切れる!

blocks.translation: I will never lose!

blocks.translation: Save the chit‑chat for later!

blocks.text: 卑怯者め。

blocks.translation: Now I understand. He's... me, Peko, you! For the sake of the weak,

blocks.translation: Kaito! Are you serious? Are you really planning to destroy the world?

blocks.text: 世界を作り変えるために、強さを求めたんだ!
blocks.translation: I sought strength to reshape the world!

blocks.text: 戒斗、見ててくれ・・・!
blocks.translation: Kaito, watch me...!
I am...

blocks.text: 決めたぜ戒斗! 俺はお前について行く!
blocks.translation: I've decided, Kaito! I'll follow you!

blocks.text: 俺は戦い続ける。 チームバロンのため、戒斗の誇りを守るため、 そして俺は、俺の弱さを確かめるために戦う!
blocks.translation: I will keep fighting. For Team Baron, to protect Kaito's pride, and to test my own weakness I will fight!

blocks.text: 加勢するぜ戒斗
blocks.translation: I'll help you, Kaito

blocks.text: なあ、戒斗、シュラにはあんな風に言っちまったが、 結局俺は･･･お前のことよく分からないんだ。
blocks.translation: Hey, Kaito, I may have said that to Shura, but in the end... I don't really understand you.

blocks.text: お前に勝ち目はない!
blocks.translation: You have no chance of winning!

blocks.text: 一番近くにいて、一番分かってるつもりだったんだけどな・・・。 大した確信もない。
blocks.translation: I thought I was closest and understood the most, but... I'm not entirely sure.

blocks.text: 今は退け...。
blocks.translation: Step back now...

blocks.text: ひとつ、聞いていいか。 どうしてあの時、 俺を殺さなかった。 殺せたはずだ。
blocks.translation: Can I ask you something? Why didn't you kill me back then? You could have killed me.

blocks.text: わりぃ、逃しちまった。
blocks.translation: Sorry, I missed it.

blocks.text: そうか。
blocks.translation: I see.

blocks.text: こいつを内緒で、シャルモンのおっさんに届けてくれ。 今はなにも聞くな。
blocks.translation: Please deliver this to the old man, Charmon, without telling anyone. Don't ask me anything now.

blocks.text: 踊ろうぜ。
blocks.translation: Let's dance.

blocks.text: 戦極凌馬･･･。

blocks.text: 戦極凌馬、 あなたが私を導いたのだ。 更なる世界へと。
blocks.translation: Sengoku Ryoma, you have led me to a new world.

blocks.text: 我々は黒の菩提樹。 あまねく世界を救う者である。
blocks.translation: We are the Black Bodhi Tree. We are those who will save the entire world.

blocks.text: 呉島天樹氏の命令により、 ロックシードの起動実験に参加した私は、あの日死んだ。 少なくとも人間としては。
blocks.translation: At Mr. Tenju Kureshima's orders, I participated in the Lockseed activation experiment and died that day. At least as a human being.

blocks.text: 世界の終わりが近づいている。 我々がもたらす救済を、受け入れるのだ。
blocks.translation: The end of the world is approaching. Accept the salvation we bring.

blocks.text: しかし、肉体を失った私は、より高位の存在に生まれ変わった。 私の目的は復讐ではない。
blocks.translation: However, having lost my body I was reborn as a higher being. My purpose is not revenge.

blocks.text: 久し振りだな、 戦極凌馬。
blocks.translation: It's been a while, Sengoku Ryoma.

blocks.text: あなたを試すことだ。 そして、確信した。
blocks.translation: I came to test you. And I am convinced.

blocks.text: 私はあなたを導きに来た。 神へと至る世界へと。 だがそのためには、試練を乗り越えなければならない。
blocks.translation: I have come to guide you — to a world that reaches God. But to do that, you must overcome trials.

blocks.text: 私は全てを失い、力を得た。 あなたはどうだ? 戦極凌馬。 あなたは神へと至る資格があるのか。
blocks.translation: I lost everything and gained power. How about you, Sengoku Ryoma? Are you worthy of reaching God?

blocks.text:
私と共に来い、 戦極凌馬。 私は神となり世界を救済する。 そのためにはあなたの力が必要だ。
あなたの目的は神を生み出すことだ。 私ならそれを叶えることができる。
blocks.translation:
Come with me, Sengoku Ryoma. I will become a god and bring salvation to the world. For that I need your power.
Your goal is to create a god. I can make that come true.

blocks.text: 私はそれを見極めなければならない。 神の力を手にして、世界を救うために。
blocks.translation: I must discern that — to obtain the power of God and save the world.

blocks.text: 呉島貴虎には無理なことだ。
blocks.translation: It's impossible for Takatora Kureshima.

blocks.text: 流石だ。 戦極凌馬。
blocks.translation: As expected, Sengoku Ryoma.

blocks.text: 戦極凌馬アー!
blocks.translation: Sengoku Ryoma—ah!

blocks.text:
私の目に狂いは無かった。 世界を救うためには、やはりあなたの力が必要なんだ。
いいだろう。 これが最後の試練だ。
blocks.translation:
My eyes were not mistaken. To save the world, I do need your power after all.
Very well. This will be the final trial.

blocks.text: 私を滅ぼすことはできない。 あなたなら理解できるはずだ。
blocks.translation: You cannot destroy me. You should be able to understand that.

blocks.text: はああっ・・・バカな･･･。
blocks.translation: Hah... impossible...

blocks.text: 私は神に至り･･･世界を救うのだ･･･。
blocks.translation: I will reach God... and save the world...

blocks.text: さあ、かかってこい。
blocks.translation: Now, come at me.

blocks.text:

blocks.translation: Our futures will never meet. So...

blocks.translation: Kouta... I couldn't stop Kaito.

blocks.text: 全部終わってしまう。何もかも、無駄になってしまう。

blocks.text: そう約束したじゃない。
blocks.translation: That's what we promised.

blocks.text: それがどういう意味だか分かってるの!?私はもう人間じゃない・・

blocks.text: これがアンタの望んだ結末か。
blocks.translation: Is this the ending you wanted?

blocks.text: 前にも言ったぞ。 お前なんかただの金メッキだ。行くぞ、ミッチ。
blocks.translation: I told you before—you're nothing but gold plating. Let's go, Mitch.

blocks.text: アンタが敵なのか、味方なのか、俺には最後までわからなかった。
blocks.translation: I never knew until the very end whether you were enemy or ally.

blocks.text: その様子だと、もう大丈夫みたいだな。言った通りだろう。もう一度やり直せるって。
blocks.translation: Looks like you're okay now. Told you so—you can start over.

blocks.text: ここまで世界をめちゃくちゃにしておいて。
blocks.translation: After making the world such a mess...

blocks.text: 貴虎と仲良くな。 あと姉ちゃんに、俺は元気だって伝えといてくれ。
blocks.translation: Get along with Takatora. And tell my sister I'm doing fine.

blocks.text:
これは世界を塗り潰す力。俺が守ろうとしたもの全てが犠牲になる。 冗談じゃない。 お断りだ。
ここで未来が無いのなら、別の世界を探せばいい。 諦めない限り道はある。
blocks.translation: This is a power that will paint over the world. Everything I tried to protect will be sacrificed. No way. I refuse. If there's no future here, then we'll find another world. As long as we don't give up, there's a way.

blocks.text: 俺たち、いつまでも仲間だぜ。 ミッチ。
blocks.translation: We're friends forever, Mitch.

blocks.text: じゃあな。 駆紋・・・戒斗。 舞 俺達も自分の未来に、進もう。
blocks.translation: See you. Kumon... Kaito. Mai—let's move forward into our own futures too.

blocks.text: この宇宙の果て。 まだ誰にも知られていないどこでもない場所。
blocks.translation: The edge of the universe. A place not yet known to anyone.

blocks.text: この世界を守るのは俺だけじゃない。 みんなの思いがこの世界を創っていく!
blocks.translation: I'm not the only one who protects this world. Everyone's feelings help create it!

blocks.text: そして、俺が望む未来の在り処だ。この世界を滅ぼして支配するよりも、
blocks.translation: And this is where the future I want lies. Rather than destroying and ruling this world,

blocks.text: それがひとつになれば、どんな困難だって絶対に乗り越えることができるんだ。
blocks.translation: If we can come together, we can overcome any difficulty.

blocks.text: 新たな世界を一から創り出す。 これが俺達の、新しいステージだ。
blocks.translation: We'll create a new world from scratch. This is our new stage.

blocks.text: 魔蛇!この世から去れ! くらえー!
blocks.translation: Maja! Get out of this world! Take this!

blocks.text: 世界を望むがままに塗り替える・・・その力が俺のものなら、どんな闇も恐れない。
blocks.translation: To repaint the world as I wish... if that power were mine, I wouldn't fear any darkness.

blocks.text: 舞は返してもらうぞ!
blocks.translation: I'll get Mai back!

blocks.text: 大丈夫さ。俺はひとりじゃない。
blocks.translation: It's okay. I'm not alone.

blocks.text: 俺は絶対に諦めない!
blocks.translation: I will never give up!

blocks.text: いつだって未来は闇の中だ。 だからこそ、 光を灯しに行く価値がある。
blocks.translation: The future is always shrouded in darkness. That's precisely why it's worth going to light the way.

blocks.text: ここからは俺のステージだ。
blocks.translation: From here on, it's my stage.

blocks.text: アンタはただ見守るだけ・・・だろ?
blocks.translation: You'll just watch over us...right?

blocks.text: 待たせたな。 みんな。
blocks.translation: Sorry to have kept you waiting, everyone.

blocks.text: 世話になったな。 さあ、行こう。
blocks.translation: Thanks for everything. Now, let's go.

blocks.text: このチャンスが来ると信じていたぜ!
blocks.translation: I knew this chance would come!

blocks.text: そんなことねえよミッチ。 お前、 すげえ頑張ったじゃねえか。
blocks.translation: No way, Mitch. You really gave it your all, didn't you?

blocks.text: 貴虎!ミッチ! 行くぜ!
blocks.translation: Takatora! Mitch! Let's go!

blocks.text: やり残したことがあってな。コウガネ、 お前を倒すことだ。
blocks.translation: There's something I left unfinished: Kougane, defeating you.

blocks.text: 俺は仮面ライダー鎧武 ･･･ なんだろう、わかりやすく言ったら、 今は宇宙の神様、か?
blocks.translation: I'm Kamen Rider Gaim... how should I put it—am I the god of the universe now?

blocks.text: 行けるかミッチ。ふたりでアイツをやっつけよう。
blocks.translation: You ready, Mitch? Let's take him down together.

blocks.text: そうだな。一緒に戦おう。
blocks.translation: Yeah. Let's fight together.

blocks.text: 変身。
blocks.translation: Transform!

blocks.text: みんなバラバラで違うからこそ、一人では気付かない新しい可能性が生まれるんだ。
blocks.translation: Because we are all different and individual, new possibilities arise that we would not notice on our own.

blocks.text: ここからは、 俺達のステージだ。
blocks.translation: From here on, it's our stage.

blocks.text: 完全じゃなくていい。俺は互いを認めて、手を取り合う未来を選ぶ!
blocks.translation: It's okay if we don't become perfect. I choose a future where we accept each other and hold hands!
